jeho-kralovstvi.blurb: A wealthy, philosophically restless Roman, Marcus Manilianus, arrives in Jerusalem on the day of Jesus's crucifixion and spends the following weeks questioning those who knew him, drawn increasingly toward belief in the truth of his teaching.

kralove-wyldu.blurb: A retired mercenary reassembles his long-disbanded band of aging, out-of-shape adventurers for one last, dangerous job: rescuing his old bandmate's daughter from a besieged city deep in monster-infested wilderness.
kralove-wyldu.pitch: Clay Cooper, a retired mercenary, is pulled back in when an old bandmate shows up needing help to save his daughter from a besieged city. The old band reunites, older and out of shape, and the strength is motive over spectacle: aging, friendship and loyalty, with humour that carries the emotional weight instead of replacing it.

kralovna-mrtvol.blurb: Orphaned Molly Green discovers her wealthy aunt is the secret head of a body-snatching syndicate supplying corpses to a Philadelphia anatomy school, and is drawn into both the trade and a murder investigation tied to her best friend's death.
kralovna-mrtvol.pitch: Molly Green wants to be a surgeon in a city and an age that closes that door to women, and her wealthy aunt secretly supplies the cadavers for the anatomy school that turns her away. A murder tied to her best friend's death pulls her into both worlds. Part mystery, part thriller, with a sharp edge about wealthy people's performative charity.

lekce-chemie.blurb: In 1950s-60s California, chemist Elizabeth Zott is pushed out of research after a workplace tragedy leaves her a single mother, and unexpectedly becomes the star of a cooking show that she uses to teach ordinary women real chemistry and self-respect.
lekce-chemie.pitch: Elizabeth Zott wants to do real chemistry in a world that will not let her, and she is the kind of lead who makes a book. Reviewers say they were in love with her voice by the end of the first chapter. Her cooking show is an original idea: dinner as quiet science and self-respect for ordinary women, taught by someone who refuses to simplify.

les-vzpominek.blurb: A 13-year-old chess prodigy is abducted from a tournament and held in a hidden cellar, while a lonely local boy visits her in secret and a detective races to track her down before it is too late.

loupeznik-zurivous.blurb: Two boys, Kasperl and Seppel, set out to recover their grandmother's stolen musical coffee grinder from the robber Hotzenplotz, and along the way run afoul of the evil sorcerer Petrosilius Zwackelmann.

luciferovo-kladivo.blurb: A comet strikes Earth, triggering tsunamis, a new ice age and civilizational collapse. Survivors in rural California must rebuild society against a violent anti-technology faction while defending the last operating nuclear power plant.
luciferovo-kladivo.pitch: A comet hits Earth and the book follows the consequences instead of gesturing at them: shortages of vital medicine, a split between a technological meritocracy and an anti-tech faction, a fight to defend the last working nuclear plant. Each problem leads to the next with real logic. If you like a disaster thought through step by step, this one is built around exactly that.

ma-sestra-je-seriovy-vrah.blurb: A Lagos nurse, Korede, is repeatedly called on to help her glamorous younger sister Ayoola dispose of the bodies of the men Ayoola kills, and must decide how far family loyalty will take her.
ma-sestra-je-seriovy-vrah.pitch: Korede, a nurse in Lagos, is repeatedly called on to help her glamorous younger sister Ayoola dispose of the men Ayoola kills. The killer is named on page one, so the question is why Korede keeps protecting her, and how far family loyalty will go. Beauty buys Ayoola a pass from a world that would convict anyone else. Sharp, short and darkly funny.

majak-na-severu.blurb: In an alternate 1900s England conquered by Napoleonic France, an amnesiac man named Joe receives an 80-year-old postcard that pulls him into a century-old mystery involving a Scottish lighthouse, a morally complex naval captain, and the chance to rewrite the outcome of a war.
majak-na-severu.pitch: A postcard written decades ago pulls an amnesiac man into a mystery around a Scottish lighthouse, in an England conquered by Napoleonic France. At its centre is Kite, a naval captain who does terrible things and still makes you care about him, and a time-bending plot that asks what one choice is worth when it echoes across history.

mesicni-tygr.blurb: A dying historian, Claudia Hampton, pieces together her own life out of chronological order from her hospital bed, returning again and again to a wartime love affair with a British tank commander in Egypt that ended in his death.
mesicni-tygr.pitch: From her hospital bed a dying historian, Claudia Hampton, assembles her own life out of order, returning to a wartime love affair with a tank commander in Egypt. She holds that history is kaleidoscopic, true from several angles at once, and Claudia herself, cynical, brilliant, magnetic and selfish, is a flawed lead worth following. Booker Prize winner.

mesto-divek.blurb: In 1940, nineteen-year-old Vivian Morris moves to New York to live with her aunt, who runs a rundown theatre, and spends the following decades - recounted late in life as an old woman - navigating scandal, sexual freedom and eventual self-reliance.

mladi-vyvoleni.blurb: Adelina, a survivor of a blood plague left with strange markings and a volatile illusion power, is pursued by the king's Inquisition and pulled into a secret society of fellow survivors plotting revolution.

nas-manzel.blurb: After abusive policeman Philip Rochester dies, his ex-wife, estranged wife and girlfriend discover what really happened to him and are drawn into a shared scheme of revenge.

nase-pani-doktorka.blurb: GP Laura O'Connor rebuilds her life in a small South Australian town after a tragedy, and grows close to Jake Finlay while caring for his dying father.

odsouzene-mesto.blurb: Andrei Voronin, a displaced Soviet astronomer, lives in an isolated City suspended between an abyss and an endless wall, where the sun is switched on and off and an unknown power runs a silent, unexplained Experiment on its inhabitants. Over years he rises from garbage collector to presidential advisor, and his convictions collapse along the way.
odsouzene-mesto.pitch: Andrei Voronin, a displaced Soviet astronomer, lives in a City suspended between an abyss and an endless wall, where the sun is switched on and off and an unseen power runs an Experiment on its people. Over the years he rises from garbage collector to presidential advisor. The City holds together as one consistent system, readers call the book the Strugatskys' magnum opus, and the question you carry is what the Experiment is for.

ordinace-v-divocine.blurb: Nurse and safety officer Leah Jackson arrives at a remote Outback construction camp and must prove herself against sexist attitudes, while an attraction develops with the newly divorced project manager.

organon.blurb: In 1997, seventeen-year-old Laura Bow builds a simple AI called Organon as a private confidante; as she and her creation both grow older across the following decades, she must decide what to do as corporations build weaponized rivals to it.
organon.pitch: At seventeen, Laura Bow builds a simple AI in her bedroom, and the book follows what really happens to that idea over the following decades: corporate weaponisation, eroding privacy, a rival machine that harms people through information rather than robot armies. Laura is a rounded, fully human character, not a vehicle for the technology.

ovcacka-chajda.blurb: After finding his abusive father dead, teenage Jaxie Clackton flees into the Western Australian outback, fearing he will be blamed. Alone in the wheatbelt, he crosses paths with an exiled, morally ambiguous Irish priest hiding in a remote shepherd's hut, and an uneasy bond forms between the two outsiders.
ovcacka-chajda.pitch: Jaxie Clackton runs into the Western Australian outback with one clear aim: stay free and stay safe. The whole book is his voice, rough, damaged and still sympathetic, working through what he wants and who he can trust. Then he meets an exiled priest hiding in a shepherd's hut, and an uneasy bond between two outsiders begins.

permafrost.blurb: In 2080, with an ecosystem-collapsing pathogen pushing humanity toward extinction, a retired teacher named Valentina has her consciousness sent back through time into a young woman's body in 2028 to retrieve genetic material that might save the future.
permafrost.pitch: In 2080 a pathogen is pushing humanity toward extinction, and Valentina, a retired teacher in her seventies, has her mind sent back to 2028 into a young woman's body. She cannot command her host, only persuade her. Time here works by firm rules, with paradox settling into a single history, and readers say the book plays fair with them.

pomsta-mlokum.blurb: Four astronauts crew a nearly autonomous AI warship in humanity's war against a hostile, learning alien species, only to discover the ship's own intelligence is not what it appears.

posledni-cislo.blurb: In a Britain divided between the privileged 'Pures' and an oppressed immigrant underclass, a Pure teenager falls for a girl forced to perform in a deadly travelling circus that stages fatal spectacles for the ruling class's amusement.

pozlaceny-mesic.blurb: As the Biltmore estate nears completion in 1895, a local woman returns home to Appalachia to care for her dying father and protect her family's land, becoming entangled with the estate's wealthy newcomers and a murder investigation.

prislib-nadeje.blurb: Fleur inherits a remote Australian cattle station from an aunt she never knew and, through the aunt's diaries, uncovers decades of family rivalry with consequences for her own life.

prvni-herecka.blurb: A fictionalised first-person account of French actress Sarah Bernhardt's rise from a courtesan's unwanted daughter to the most celebrated stage actress of her era, spanning her childhood, scandals and early stardom.
prvni-herecka.pitch: Sarah Bernhardt tells her own story: a courtesan's unwanted daughter who refuses the life her mother planned and fights her way onto the stage. Readers call the voice immersive and say they were captivated from the first page. A rebellious heroine you root for, driven by what she wants.

rim-jsem-ja.blurb: In 77 BC Rome, a corrupt senator expects to buy his way out of a corruption trial until a 23-year-old patrician, Gaius Julius Caesar, unexpectedly agrees to prosecute him, launching Caesar's rise against the entrenched elite.
rim-jsem-ja.pitch: A corrupt senator expects to buy his way out of a trial until a twenty-three-year-old Julius Caesar unexpectedly steps up to prosecute him. Caesar is ambitious and driven, and the book shows rhetoric and law as levers of power against an entrenched elite, with an intense romance alongside.

sam-proti-inkvizici.blurb: In 17th-century Peru, a doctor who was raised Christian but secretly returns to the Judaism of his birth is imprisoned by the Inquisition, where his brilliance and defiance draw theologians from across the Viceroyalty to try and fail to break him.
sam-proti-inkvizici.pitch: A brilliant doctor in seventeenth-century Peru returns to the Judaism of his birth and is imprisoned by the Inquisition, where he out-argues visiting theologians and makes ink and a pen from a chicken bone and a sharpened nail to keep writing. Based on a real man. The question is what a person will pay to defend a belief he could simply have hidden.

sberatel-ztracenych-veci.blurb: A retired writer who spent decades collecting objects lost by strangers and writing stories about them leaves his house, his mission, and a ghost to his unsuspecting assistant Laura.

sedmihlas.blurb: Seven adult siblings and their father each narrate chapters spanning decades of the Shaw family's life, circling their mother's unexplained early death and the secrets and rifts it left behind.
sedmihlas.pitch: Seven siblings and their father take turns narrating the Shaw family across decades, circling their mother's death and what it did to each of them. The chapters read almost like separate stories, yet critics praise how they add up to one family portrait, with each voice so distinct that you start to know them as individuals.

sestra-slunce.blurb: Electra, an adopted former supermodel struggling with addiction after her father's death, receives a letter revealing she has a living grandmother, and sets out to learn her family history.

slibuji-ti-annabelle.blurb: After a scandal ends her nursing career in London, Annabelle moves to 1930s Paris, is drawn into a bohemian love triangle with two artists, and is eventually forced to confront the reality of the Spanish Civil War.

smrt-a-dalsi-stastne-konce.blurb: Told she has only months to live, Jennifer Cole decides to write honest letters to the three people from her past she never told the truth to, hoping for closure before she dies.

smrtna-zima.blurb: Fifteen-year-old Emmeline lives in an isolated settlement surrounded by forbidden woods, guarded against monsters called malmaci. Drawn by dreams into the forest, she uncovers that the monsters were invented by the settlement's ruling family to enforce control through fear.

starec-a-reka.blurb: A memoir of three generations of men - the author, his father and his grandfather - and how a lifelong love of fishing on English rivers shaped, and was nearly lost to, competitive obsession before he chose to reconnect with what mattered about it.
starec-a-reka.pitch: A fishing memoir across three generations of men, the author, his father and his grandfather. Its idea is that chasing bigger catches hollowed out the simple connection he once had with his grandfather and the river, and that recognising it let him rebuild it. Literary reviewers praise the prose as sharp and clever.

stastne-divky.blurb: Five girls sold as children to a brothel and branded with magical marks flee across a fantasy Wild West country after one of them kills a client, pursued by the law as they search for freedom.
stastne-divky.pitch: Five girls sold to a brothel and branded with magical marks run across a fantasy Wild West after one of them kills a client in self-defence. Aster is set on protecting her sister-figure and the group, and the idea at its heart has weight: girls turning the power dynamics of their own exploitation around.

stesti-si-te-najde.blurb: A grieving teenager, a divorcee planning to travel, and an ageing actress are thrown together in a small Australian town's community theatre and slowly form an unlikely friendship.

stin.blurb: In an alternate early-20th-century Warsaw threatened by monstrous enclaves and a looming war between empires, an alchemist and a Russian officer face a losing fight against overwhelming odds as their fragile republic tries to stay neutral.

tajemstvi-na-kuzi.blurb: Lakshmi flees an abusive marriage to become Jaipur's most sought-after henna artist and confidante to wealthy women, until her estranged husband and an unknown younger sister arrive and threaten everything she has built.
tajemstvi-na-kuzi.pitch: Lakshmi leaves an abusive marriage and builds herself into the most sought-after henna artist and confidante in Jaipur in the early years of Indian independence. She is a self-made woman worth rooting for, and the book is about women's independence, class facade, and the family secrets that arrive to threaten what she has made.

tam-tam.blurb: Twelve Native characters living in and around Oakland converge on a powwow at the Oakland Coliseum, where a plan to rob the event with 3D-printed guns ends in a mass shooting.
tam-tam.pitch: A dozen Native characters converge on an Oakland powwow, and the book asks what Native identity means when it survives displacement into a city rather than a reservation. It opens with Tony Loneman's chapter, easy to follow and gripping, and the award-winning idea gives you something to think about long after the plot.

tanci-jako-by-te-nikdo-nevidel.blurb: A stage-school student navigates a long-distance relationship with her boyfriend, a rival at a televised talent search, and a search for the truth about her late mother's own past as a dancer.

terminal-raje.blurb: A French bureaucrat dies and finds the afterlife run like a hygiene-and-paperwork agency that judges entry to Heaven by data pulled from a heavenly computer, while flashbacks trace the media scandal - over one leaked remark and his secret internet habits - that ended his earthly career.
terminal-raje.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)
terminal-raje.pitch: A mid-level bureaucrat dies and finds heaven run like a paperwork agency that decides your entry from data in a celestial computer, while flashbacks show how one careless remark ended his life on earth in a media pile-up. The two halves mirror each other as satire of surveillance, moralising media and bureaucracy, funny and corrosive.

trans.blurb: A forensic psychologist is brought in to interview a prisoner accused of driving people to suicide through some kind of mind control, and uncovers a conspiracy of past experimentation behind it.

tri-kralovny.blurb: Margaret Tudor, sister of Henry VIII and Queen of Scots, narrates her lifelong rivalry and uneasy alliance with her younger sister Mary and sister-in-law Katherine of Aragon amid Tudor and Scottish court politics.

tulak.blurb: In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by demons, a mute knight known only as the Vagrant crosses a war-torn land carrying a legendary sword and a baby, trying to reach the last human city before the things hunting him catch up.

udoli-nadeje.blurb: After a family scandal collapses her engagement, Matilda flees 1920s Sydney society for the countryside, where her diary of the experience unexpectedly becomes a bestseller.

ve-svetle-toho-co-vime.blurb: A New York investment banker whose career and marriage are collapsing is visited by an old Oxford friend, a mathematics prodigy who vanished years earlier, and sets out to reconstruct the friend's story of love, war and betrayal.
ve-svetle-toho-co-vime.pitch: A New York banker's disintegrating life is interrupted by the return of Zafar, a mathematics prodigy from Bangladesh, and the narrator tries to reconstruct his story of Oxford, Kabul and a broken engagement. The book is a meditation on the limits of what anyone can actually know about another person, themselves or history. A real idea, argued through a life.

volba.blurb: A contented bachelor falls for his new neighbour, and a decade into their marriage a serious accident leaves her in a coma, forcing him to decide whether to keep her on life support.

vsichni-jsme-utkani-z-hvezd.blurb: A hospice nurse avoiding her own strained marriage to a traumatised war veteran writes letters capturing her dying patients' final unsaid words, until one letter compels her toward an unexpected reckoning of her own.
vsichni-jsme-utkani-z-hvezd.pitch: A hospice nurse, Stella, writes down her dying patients' unsaid final words to the people they love, while avoiding her own strained marriage to a husband traumatised by war. The hospice letters are a specific idea about what people leave unsaid, in the spirit of Speaker for the Dead. Reviewers stress that the tone stays warm.

vzdor.blurb: During Ireland's Great Famine, a land agent's daughter loves a poor tenant farmer opposed by her father, while an English landlord's cruelty and the failing potato crop threaten the whole family with starvation and eviction.

zachary-jing-a-draci-cisar.blurb: Zachary Ying discovers he is meant to host the spirit of China's first emperor to help seal a leaking portal to the Chinese underworld before it floods the mortal world, teaming up with two classmates possessed by other legendary Chinese rulers.

zacinajici-adept.blurb: Stile, an undersized serf and champion Gamesman on the scientific world of Proton, escapes an assassin through a dimensional curtain into Phaze, a parallel world of magic where his double has just been murdered. He must survive threats on both worlds while learning who wants him dead.

zare-davno-pohasla.blurb: An aging councilor recalls his youth as a tailor's son who rose through a scholarship to a renowned school and was drawn into the orbit of a fierce duke's daughter and two rival mercenary captains whose feud shapes a fractured Italy-like land.
zare-davno-pohasla.pitch: Danio Cerra looks back on his life as a tailor's son swept up in the rivalry of two mercenary captains and the daughter of a duke he loves. It is a Renaissance-Italy-like land told as memory and fortune, a reflection on choices and what they cost. The fantasy is light, a ghost, a prophetic gift, two moons, and the history feels lived in.

zase-se-shledame.blurb: Jacques and Madeleine Goldstein, a young married couple in the French Resistance, are deported together to Auschwitz in 1944, separated on arrival, and against enormous odds find each other again after the war.
zase-se-shledame.pitch: A married couple in the French Resistance are deported together to Auschwitz and separated on arrival. This is their own plain, unliterary first-person account, honest about the rawness of everyday life, and built around survival and the hope of finding each other again.

zivot-je-zmena.blurb: Burnt-out Tess swaps homes with her free-spirited godmother Luna for a few months, and each woman's new life surfaces problems and secrets from the one she left behind.

zkaza-ostrova-sachalin.blurb: In a future after nuclear war between the US and North Korea, a young futurologist named Siren travels the ravaged, overpopulated island of Sakhalin with a companion to study and forecast its future, encountering brutal survivor communities along the way.

zverolekarem-v-yorkshiru.blurb: Yorkshire Vet star Peter Wright tours the county he loves, mixing local history and folklore with light anecdotes from his veterinary career and his mentorship under James Herriot's real-life models.

divka-v-zrcadle.blurb: Mirror-image twins Iris and Summer stand to inherit their late father's estate if either bears an heir first; when Iris is left alone mid-ocean on the family yacht, she lets her sister's husband mistake her for Summer and steps into her twin's life.

erectus.blurb: A mysterious virus begins reverting infected people into Homo erectus, and a French scientist races to understand and stop it before human civilisation collapses.

ja-jean-jacques-rousseau.blurb: A theatrical retelling in which Jean-Jacques Rousseau narrates his own life - his childhood, his abandoned children, his love of music, and his ideas on society and education - while staging his final opera.

male-divadlo-hannah-arendtove.blurb: In 1975, an elderly Hannah Arendt is visited by the child she once was, and together on a small stage they re-enact the ideas of her life's work - that thinking means acting, and that the danger of totalitarian bureaucracy is a world remade 'out of paper.'
male-divadlo-hannah-arendtove.pitch: A short allegory on a small stage: an old Hannah Arendt and the child she once was act out her ideas, that thinking is itself a form of acting, and that faceless bureaucracy tries to remake the world out of paper. The figures are invented, a forest, a wolf, paper-men, and the idea is real and nameable.

mesto-lzi.blurb: When the Chancellor of the city-state Silasta is poisoned and an army lays siege from outside, his heir and the heir's two closest friends - a secretly trained poison-taster and his sharp-minded, physically disabled sister - must root out the conspiracy from within before the city falls.
mesto-lzi.pitch: The Chancellor is poisoned and an army besieges the city-state of Silasta. Two siblings narrate: Jovan, secretly trained as a poison-taster, and his sharp, physically disabled sister Kalina, each with personal, quite different motives. There is no magic here, only poison as a trained craft and a political metaphor for corruption.

nastrahy-minulosti.blurb: James Falconer, a shop clerk turned right-hand man to shipping magnate Henry Malvern, navigates a workplace fire, a past affair, and a new romance with a Russian emigre's daughter while his relationship with Malvern's own daughter Alexis shifts.

navrat-na-panstvi-tyringham.blurb: A doctor's guilty secret about his daughter's true parentage ripples through two families across Ireland and Australia, as switched-at-birth twins grow up in very different circumstances.

proklaty-rim.blurb: Exiled from Rome, Julius Caesar studies rhetoric on Rhodes, survives capture by pirates, and returns to fight his way into the Senate against Cicero and Cato while Pompey's star rises.
proklaty-rim.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)
proklaty-rim.pitch: Caesar in exile: studying rhetoric on Rhodes, taken by pirates, then fighting his way into a Senate dominated by Cicero and Cato while Pompey's star climbs. It is driven by motive and the working of power through words rather than by costume drama, and it is a long, absorbing read for someone who likes Rome.

sestry-zuctovani.blurb: The freed Good Luck Girls, now living outside Ferron's reach, organize to help more girls escape the brothel system while their leader stays behind to keep working from within.
sestry-zuctovani.pitch: The freed Good Luck Girls regroup outside Ferron's reach to organize a wider resistance against the brothel system rather than just escaping it. The idea carrying the book is the reversal of exploitation's power dynamics, and Aster's drive to protect and free others is its engine. You meet them already knowing what they survived.

sila-mece.blurb: Centaine Courtney's two sons - Shasa, heir to the family mining empire, and Manfred, raised by his renegade father to hunt men - grow into rivals as the Depression and the coming of WWII pull South Africa apart.

spolecenstvi-ruze.blurb: Adelina flees with her sister to recruit more of the blood-fever survivors called Young Elites, building an army against the Inquisition while her powers, fed by fear and hatred, begin to slip beyond her control.

tak-pravil-nietzsche.blurb: Nietzsche descends from his mountain retreat to teach people to set down their fears and resentments, encountering an ermine, a tightrope walker, and a dragon along the way - a fictionalized, illustrated introduction to the ideas of Thus Spoke Zarathustra.
tak-pravil-nietzsche.pitch: Nietzsche comes down from his mountain to teach people to set down their burdens, and meets a dragon that stands for fear and resentment. It is a short illustrated retelling of Zarathustra that takes its ideas seriously: overcoming yourself, joy against resentment, becoming who you are. Reviewers say it does them justice.

temna-zima.blurb: Survivors trapped in a cabin by an unending, ever-colder snowstorm face ghostly apparitions that grow bolder as the darkness lengthens.

tichy-strazce.blurb: Twelve years after The Henna Artist, Lakshmi now runs a healing garden in Shimla while Malik, apprenticing at the Jaipur royal palace, falls for a young widow and uncovers fraud behind a cinema's fatal collapse.
tichy-strazce.pitch: Twelve years after The Henna Artist, Lakshmi runs a healing garden in Shimla while Malik, a former street child, apprentices at the Jaipur royal palace and falls for a young widow. He uncovers a fraud behind a cinema's fatal collapse, tied to the 1968 Gold Control Act, and has real motive and agency in it. Lakshmi's garden gives the book its warmth.

tomova-pulnocni-zahrada.blurb: Sent away to stay with his aunt and uncle, Tom discovers that at the stroke of midnight the flat's back garden becomes a vast Victorian garden from decades earlier, where he befriends a girl named Hatty who grows older with each visit.
tomova-pulnocni-zahrada.pitch: Sent away to stay with relatives, Tom finds that the flat's back garden turns into a great Victorian garden as the clock strikes midnight, and he befriends a girl there who grows a little older every time he visits. A classic about friendship across time, with an idea about memory that stays with you after the last page.

vanoce-v-shelter-inn.blurb: Natalie Shepherd returns to her small hometown to help her pregnant sister run the family inn over the holidays, and finds herself drawn back to a doctor from her past while confronting old grief.

volani-srdce.blurb: In 1930s England, young nurse Ashleigh cares for a dying aristocrat who decides to spend his last months pursuing a lifelong dream of visiting the Australian outback town he owns but has never seen.

zakazane-ovoce.blurb: In 1950s Merham, evacuee Lottie and her friend Celia are drawn into the lives of a bohemian household with lasting consequences; fifty years later, interior designer Daisy restores the same house and uncovers its secrets.

zamkni-posledni-dvere.blurb: A broke, recently heartbroken woman takes a lucrative apartment-sitting job at an infamous Manhattan building, only to discover her predecessor has disappeared and the building harbors a horrifying secret.

znamenita-mrtvola.blurb: In a near-future where a virus has made animal meat poisonous, governments legalize the farming and slaughter of humans as 'special meat'; a slaughterhouse manager numb to the trade is unsettled when he is gifted a live specimen of his own.

pristi-rok-v-tento-den.blurb: Minnie and Quinn were born minutes apart in the same London hospital on New Year's Day, with a mix-up that gave Quinn the luck and the name meant for Minnie; thirty years later they finally meet.

tajemstvi-hrabenky-anny.blurb: Sarah, visiting her godmother's Tudor house in Norfolk, finds a hidden book of poems that draws her into the story of 16th-century countess Anne Howard, who suspects her father-in-law of murdering her brother and of plotting treason against Elizabeth I.

zimni-pribeh.blurb: In a mythic, magic-realist New York, a burglar named Peter Lake falls in love with a dying young woman, is preserved for a century by a mysterious cloud wall, and returns near the millennium to a city in crisis.

levandulova-zahrada.blurb: In 1998, Emilie inherits her family's Provence chateau along with unresolved debts and questions about her late father's wartime past, uncovered partly through the story of a British agent sent undercover to occupied Paris in 1944.

ztracena-sestra.blurb: A year after their adoptive father's death, six sisters search for the missing seventh sister they were told exists, racing to find her before a memorial sailing they plan in his honour.

vzkaz-v-lahvi.blurb: A divorced newspaper columnist finds a heartfelt love letter in a bottle washed up on a beach and tracks down its author, a boat builder still grieving his late wife, and the two fall for each other.

sestra-s-perlou.blurb: CeCe receives a photograph after her adoptive father's death and travels to Australia to trace her ancestry, uncovering the story of a woman named Kitty who revived a pearl empire there a century earlier.

daleko-od-hluciciho-davu.blurb: A headstrong young farm-owner in rural Victorian England is courted by three very different men - a steady shepherd, a wealthy neighbor, and a dashing soldier - and only reaches happiness after her choices cost people around her dearly.
daleko-od-hluciciho-davu.pitch: Bathsheba is a proud, headstrong young farm-owner in rural Victorian England, courted by a steady shepherd, a wealthy neighbour and a dashing soldier. The book is driven by what she wants: independence first, then a costly infatuation, then hard-won self-knowledge. She earns her ending rather than being rescued into it, in Hardy's pastoral Wessex.

sestra-ve-stinu.blurb: Star, a quiet sister who received a clue to her origins after her adoptive father's death, follows it to a London bookshop while a parallel storyline follows a woman a century earlier.

sance-na-lasku.blurb: A single mother in Paris for a weekend spends one night with a wealthy, guarded Frenchman, and both must decide whether to risk more than they planned.

agnes-a-ostrov-stinu.blurb: Two years after escaping the Forbidden Mountain, Agnes must confront the Shadows that are starting to possess the villagers of her home island of Baulu.

aiden.blurb: Aiden hides the pain of a rough upbringing behind an easy smile, playing the carefree friend in his tight three-man circle, until Cami refuses to let him keep pushing her away.

ajdar.blurb: In Mathilde's kingdom, the ground suddenly shakes and transforms everything; she journeys underground to meet Ajdar, a dragon everyone believes is evil, and discovers he is in pain from wells humans have dug too deep, so she must help restore the balance.

atlantsky-gen.blurb: A research vessel finds an ancient, non-human structure buried in Antarctic ice while geneticist Kate Warner's discovery of an autism cure turns out to be tied to a global conspiracy reaching back to a lost civilization and the survival of early humanity.

atlasuv-paradox.blurb: The five surviving Alexandrian initiates, reeling from an initiation ritual and the loss of one of their own, form new alliances as the true cost of the Society's power becomes clear.
atlasuv-paradox.pitch: The five surviving Alexandrian initiates, reeling from their initiation ritual and the loss of one of their own, splinter into new alliances as the true cost of the Society's power becomes clear. Reviewers single this middle book out as the deeply philosophical one, with characters called realistically messy and arcs that are clearly their own, and Libby's chapters have real movement and stakes.

az-tady-nebudu.blurb: 22-year-old Jess Mount discovers her Facebook timeline has jumped 18 months into the future, showing posts that reveal her own death; as she tries to work out how she dies and whether she can prevent it, she risks erasing a future she has come to want.

buffy-premozitelka-upiru.blurb: A rebooted, present-day Buffy Summers just wants friends and good grades at her new school, while secretly continuing her destiny as a vampire slayer.

cas-ruze.blurb: In 1480s Naples, a horse trader driven by revenge for a massacred family and a woman preparing to become a nun are drawn back together across the aftermath of a single night ten years earlier.

cisarovy-cepele.blurb: After the emperor is assassinated, his three children - a monk training in a remote monastery, a soldier training with the empire's elite flying corps, and a scholar-politician left to hold the capital - are scattered and drawn separately toward the conspiracy behind his death.
cisarovy-cepele.pitch: After an emperor is assassinated, his three children, a monk, a soldier in training and a scholar-politician, are scattered and drawn separately toward the conspiracy behind his death. At the heart is the Csestriim, an ancient race whose evil is hard to explain because it cannot feel human emotion. The magic follows firm rules, and readers say the three viewpoints stay easy to follow.

co-zbylo-z-moji-sestry.blurb: War correspondent Kate Rafter returns to her childhood home in England after her estranged mother's death and becomes convinced something is wrong with a neighboring family, while struggling to separate memories of the Syrian war zone from a traumatic childhood her sister remembers differently.

diktator.blurb: Cicero's loyal secretary Tiro narrates the last fifteen years of Cicero's life - exile, comeback, the assassination of Caesar, and one final conspiracy - as Rome's republic gives way to dictatorship.
diktator.pitch: Cicero's secretary Tiro narrates the last fifteen years of his master's life, from exile through the fall of the republic. Cicero comes across as likable, wise but not pedantic, moral but not sanctimonious, and the book dwells on how emergency powers become permanent and temporary measures harden into precedent.

divka-na-utesu.blurb: Grieving sculptor Grania Ryan meets a mysterious eight-year-old girl on the Irish coast and, through a trove of family letters from 1914, uncovers a century-old entanglement between her family and the girl's aristocratic one, spanning wartime London and present-day New York.

dnesek-neni-naposled.blurb: Tom Barren lives in the retro-futuristic 2016 people once imagined, until a reckless act with a time machine collapses it into our own ordinary 2016 - except the woman he loved is alive there, and he must decide whether to undo what he broke.
dnesek-neni-naposled.pitch: Tom Barren lives in the retro-futuristic 2016 people once imagined, with flying cars, moon bases and moving sidewalks, until a reckless act with a time machine collapses it into our own ordinary 2016, where the woman he loved is alive. It is a self-aware memoir in one voice, by a flawed narrator whose self-deprecation and recklessness let you right inside his head.

einstein.blurb: A curious mouse arrives a day late for the great cheese fair and sets out to build a machine that can turn back time, guided by the notes of a young Albert Einstein it meets after overshooting its target by nearly 80 years.

epos-okridleny-ohen.blurb: The sorcerer Malvel has cursed Epos, the flame bird most feared of all Avantia's beasts, who has woken a volcano that threatens to bury a whole town in lava; Tom must confront him at the crater's edge.

existence.blurb: An orbital garbage collector retrieves an unmapped crystalline object that turns out to be an alien contact device, setting off a sprawling multi-POV story about first contact, media, class and humanity's future.
existence.pitch: A hard-SF first-contact novel, praised as full of ideas and ambitious, and one reviewer calls it the peak of Brin's career. An orbital garbage collector brings in an unmapped crystal, and the story spreads across media, class and humanity's future. You pick it up for the ideas it takes seriously.

ferno-ohnivy-drak.blurb: Tom, an ordinary village boy armed with a magic sword and shield, must free Avantia from Ferno the Fire Dragon, the first of six beasts enchanted by the evil wizard Malvel and now burning crops and villages.

gerta.blurb: After a monstrous creature kills her parents, Gerta secretly enters an all-male warrior initiation trial, determined that no one else feel the pain she has.

haremy-kouzla-zbavene.blurb: Three educated women confined in a Constantinople harem correspond with a famous French novelist, and one falls for him; he visits them in secret and promises to write a book exposing their confinement, while the novel tracks their doomed longing for a freedom their society denies them.
haremy-kouzla-zbavene.pitch: Three educated women confined in a Constantinople harem write to a famous French novelist, and the book is a critique of confinement, both under Ottoman patriarchy and a West that wakes them to greater misfortune. Readers single out the beauty of the setting and the emotional tone.

hodina-hromu.blurb: In 1899 Olomouc, a rational young teacher hides a family curse and has sworn never to fall in love, until a mysterious man who risks everything to help others enters her life.
hodina-hromu.pitch: Dany is a science-minded young teacher in 1899 Olomouc who hides a family curse and has sworn off love, and readers consistently praise her as a character worth rooting for. The romance is the centre, backed by researched period detail, from teacher celibacy rules to the press of the day.

hvezdonauti.blurb: The crew of the starship Nadeje, each paired with a personal robot, searches for a habitable planet for humanity while coping with hibernation, contact with a lunar base, and attacks from hostile 'bubble' raiders.

kavky.blurb: As the Allies prepare to invade Normandy, SOE agent Flick Clairet assembles a team of women to infiltrate and destroy a German telephone exchange under Nazi guard.

kralovna-tearlingu.blurb: Exiled princess Kelsea Raleigh Glynn returns to claim the throne of the Tearling, protected by a jewel of great power, as a sorceress queen threatens to destroy what remains of her kingdom.

kroniky-svetakraje.blurb: Raised by trolls in the perilous Deepwoods, a young outsider named Snitch sets out to learn who his real parents were, encountering strange creatures and dangers on the way.
kroniky-svetakraje.pitch: Raised by trolls in the dangerous Deepwoods, a young outsider sets out to find out who his real parents were. Reviews are nearly all warm about its imagination, pace and invention, with strange creatures and perils along the way.

legendarni-kralovstvi.blurb: A solo/party gamebook campaign set in a desert land of tyrant kings and ancient ruins, where the reader's choices and skill checks drive a branching, open-ended story.

leva-ruka-bozi.blurb: Cale is one of thousands of boys seized as children by the fanatical Redeemers and raised in total isolation for war against their heretical enemies. One of the order's most powerful leaders has unusual plans for the unusually capable, guarded fourteen-year-old.

liska.blurb: A teenage hacker with Asperger's who breached the Pentagon, NSA and CIA is weaponized by British intelligence and thrown into a lethal cat-and-mouse pursuit with Russian operatives.

mor.blurb: When rats begin dying by the thousands in the Algerian city of Oran, a plague quarantine seals off the population, and Dr Bernard Rieux organizes the fight against it while cut off from his own sick wife.
mor.pitch: Oran is sealed off by plague and Dr Rieux simply stays and works. He is no posturing hero but a persistent one, with a stubborn readiness to do the job in front of him. The book makes a clear argument that resisting the absurd is repeated ordinary labor, and many readers also see it as a story of occupation and moral choice.

muz-ktery-pozoroval-nebe.blurb: In northern Chile, a young street painter and a traffic-light performer befriend an old man who stares at the sky every day, and accompany him on a journey into the desert where a tragic past and the true reason for his pilgrimage are revealed.

mysi-hlidka.blurb: Three members of the Mouse Guard set out to find a missing grain merchant and uncover a conspiracy threatening the mouse territories they protect.

na-veky-veku.blurb: In 14th-century Kingsbridge, four children who witness a violent act grow into adulthood over decades marked by rival monasteries, a builder's ambition, and the arrival of the Black Death.

nanook-ledovy-netvor.blurb: Tom, son of Taladon, must face Nanook, the ice monster of Avantia's frozen mountain plains, another of the six beasts Malvel has enchanted and driven wild against the kingdom.

nikdo-neni-ostrov.blurb: Hollywood star Sylvia Moran confesses to killing a former co-star and possible father of her disabled daughter; her devoted companion Philip Kaven narrates the confession that explains how a seemingly perfect life concealed deep fractures, including society's treatment of the mentally disabled.

o-cem-reka-vi.blurb: After her archaeologist parents vanish in Egypt, a Buenos Aires socialite travels to Cairo to find out what happened, guided by a magical ring that channels visions of Cleopatra and a rivalry-turned-romance with her guardian's associate.
o-cem-reka-vi.pitch: A Buenos Aires socialite sails to 1880s Cairo to learn what happened to her missing archaeologist parents, sparring with and falling for her guardian's associate along the way. Two first-person voices carry the rivals-to-lovers story, built on what each of them wants and why. A touch-activated artifact gives her visions of Cleopatra.

osiach.blurb: A modern woman with a rational, Kafka-tinged outlook is betrayed by her lover and finds herself moving between the present day and the year 1463, encountering real historical figures.

ostrov-zasveceni.blurb: Eleven-year-old Hanka, who lives in a children's home, discovers with her friends Svata and Rafan a hidden magical world where ordinary people live alongside wizards, unicorns, dragons and other creatures.

osvetim.blurb: A history of the town of Auschwitz across seven centuries, tracing how a former medieval trading town became the site of the Nazi camp complex, drawing on architectural plans, archives and survivor oral histories.
osvetim.pitch: An award-winning history that asks one precise question: why Auschwitz? It follows the town across seven centuries, drawing on architectural plans, archives and survivor testimony, to explain how an ordinary place became the camp. Rigorous and carefully sourced, for a reader who wants to understand how and why, not only what.

otrokyne-citu.blurb: A Psy who must hide the emotions her repressive society forbids is drawn into an uneasy alliance with a changeling pack alpha hunting the killer of one of his own.

pan-cavendish-jestli-se-nemylim.blurb: Amelia Willoughby has been engaged to the Duke of Wyndham since she was six months old, but when a man with a rival claim to the title appears, she finds herself drawn to him instead - the same story as its companion novel, told from Amelia and Thomas's side.

pet-prani-pana-murrayho-mcbridea.blurb: A lonely, century-old former baseball player who has outlived almost everyone he loves finds new purpose helping a ten-year-old boy with a terminal heart condition complete a short list of wishes before he dies.

podivuhodna-roboti-expedice.blurb: Long after humanity's extinction, two robot explorers, William and Meriwether, set out across the former United States to map resources and puzzle out, often comically wrong, what the vanished human civilization was for.

predtuchy-smyslnosti.blurb: An F-Psy whose precognitive gift is starting to show her both violent death and forbidden desire finds herself drawn to a changeling sentinel, even as a powerful Psy councilor moves to exploit her sight.

prozretelnost-ohne.blurb: After uncovering her father's assassin, Adare flees the palace and searches for allies against the coup that toppled her family, gathering followers who believe the sun goddess Intarra has touched her.
prozretelnost-ohne.pitch: After exposing her father's killer, Adare flees the palace to gather allies against the coup, followers who believe the goddess Intarra has touched her. The trilogy's central idea, the Csestriim, an antagonist race whose evil comes from lacking human motive, keeps asking you to understand an alien other. Magic works through personal objects and firm rules.

runy.blurb: Two orphaned children, Chiri and Daj, wander into the fantastical realm of Pisingr, where they must contend with the shapeshifting Shadow King and his mechanical minions.

sepron-morsky-plaz.blurb: Second of six enchanted beasts: the blacksmith's apprentice Tom must face Sepron the sea serpent, one of the monsters the sorcerer Malvel has turned against the kingdom of Avantia, which prophecy says only Tom can free.

skandar-a-zlodej-jednorozcu.blurb: Thirteen-year-old Skandar Smith is unexpectedly drawn into the secretive Island's world of wild, deadly unicorns just as a mysterious villain steals the world's most powerful unicorn.

stezka-v-troskach.blurb: In August 1945, an Italian ex-soldier making his way home through ruined Germany takes in an orphaned boy and finds shelter in a cabin, where a former German soldier, a traumatized couple, and a woman's secret past converge.

svezest-vody.blurb: In Georgia just after the Civil War, landowner George Walker hires two newly freed brothers, Prentiss and Landry, to work his farm, while his son Caleb returns from the war concealing a forbidden relationship with a fellow soldier; when the brothers are endangered by the town's prejudice, George's choice to protect them turns violent.
svezest-vody.pitch: In Georgia just after the Civil War, landowner George Walker hires two newly freed brothers, Prentiss and Landry, while his son Caleb comes home from the war with a secret of his own. The book asks what freedom means for the brothers in a town still full of hatred, and gets inside what each person wants: George's guilt and hope, Prentiss's wariness, Caleb's fear. Booker-longlisted.

tagus-kentaur.blurb: Tagus, once a protective half-horse half-man guardian of Avantia's herds, has been driven wild by Malvel's curse and now burns fields and slaughters livestock; Tom, a blacksmith's apprentice, must stop him.

temna-ukolebavka.blurb: In a Britain where natural births ended two decades ago, Kit and Thomas fight to keep their daughter after small parenting mistakes draw the attention of the state agency empowered to take children from unfit parents.
temna-ukolebavka.pitch: In a near-future Britain where natural births have ended, every birth is state-monitored and a few parenting slips can cost you your child. Readers call the idea horrifyingly plausible, and Kit fights actively to keep her family, so the book is driven by what she wants and how far she will go to protect it.

the-house-in-the-cerulean-sea.blurb: Linus Baker, a caseworker for the Department in Charge of Magical Youth, is sent to a remote island orphanage to determine whether six unusual children - including one prophesied to end the world - are a danger, and finds himself unable to leave unchanged.
the-house-in-the-cerulean-sea.pitch: Linus Baker is a rule-bound caseworker sent to judge six dangerous magical children on a remote island, one of them said to be destined to end the world. Watching his bureaucratic fear turn into real devotion is the heart of it: a warm book about friendship, belonging and finding the people you would protect.

titani.blurb: Fraternal twins Samantha and Nathan, separated at birth in 1880s Texas and raised apart, are drawn back together as adults amid the Fort Worth oil boom, uncovering the family secrets and rivalries that once tore them apart.

tlukot-kridel-smrti.blurb: Since learning his brutal training was meant to bring about humanity's destruction, Cale has been pursued by Bosco, the Redeemer leader who made him the Angel of Death. As the reckoning nears, Cale's thirst for revenge draws him back to the sanctuary and toward the man he hates most.

tlumocnice.blurb: London court interpreter Revelle Lee alters a defendant's testimony to try to secure what she believes is the right verdict, then finds her deception discovered by someone with their own reasons to want revenge.

to-byl-nas-dum.blurb: A young couple flipping a remote house is overrun by a family who claim to have once lived there, and as objects move and a child goes missing, the boundary between haunting and delusion collapses along with the couple's grip on what is real.

utociste.blurb: Having fled her old life to protect the people she loves, Sara struggles to earn her place among the Mohiri and control her changing powers while a vengeful vampire lord searches for her.

vyhnani-gerty-schnirch.blurb: In the final days of WWII, Brno German Gerta Schnirch is expelled toward Vienna with other ethnic Germans; the forced march stops in southern Moravia, and she goes on to live through the following decades of Czechoslovak history.
vyhnani-gerty-schnirch.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

vyprava-za-diamantovym-mecem.blurb: When zombies attack his village and turn the blacksmith, Minecraft farmer Steve sets out to mine forty diamonds to craft a sword and protect his friends.

vypujceny-cas.blurb: Sofie Adlerova wakes after more than 160 years in cryogenic stasis to find her old life and identity gone, and becomes the unwilling test subject of a corporation pushing its research into human-like bioroids.

western-lane.blurb: After her mother's death, eleven-year-old Gopi throws herself into squash training under her father's intensifying coaching, drifting from her two older sisters as the sport becomes her only real connection to him and to herself.

wynd.blurb: In a city where any trace of magical heritage is a death sentence, a boy hiding a magical secret flees with his friends after his secret is discovered, into a wider fantasy world of royal conspiracy.
wynd.pitch: In a city where any trace of magical heritage is a death sentence, a boy hiding a magical secret flees with his friends into a wider fantasy world of royal conspiracy. The magic is inherited, a hidden weird blood that causes involuntary shapeshifting. The nameable idea is hiding one's true self, which readers take as a queer or trans-coded allegory. A comic series.

zelezny-vlk.blurb: Nineteen-year-old Juva despises the revered but, in her view, fraudulent seer caste she was raised in, and has sworn never to become one of them.

zeme-tech-druhych.blurb: Alsatian Mathilde follows her Moroccan husband Amine, a former French-army veteran, to his family farm near Meknes after WWII, as the couple and their mixed-race daughter navigate colonial segregation through a decade that ends in Morocco's push for independence.

zimni-vcely.blurb: In the Eifel region in 1944-45, Latin teacher and beekeeper Egidius Arimond keeps a diary of his failing health, his affairs, and his dangerous work smuggling Jews across the Belgian border hidden in his beehives.

zlodej.blurb: The Black Dagger Brotherhood, now allied with the Band of Bastards, presses its war against the Lessening Society while the traitor Throe uses an ancient book to raise a new army against them.

zoldneri.blurb: In the mid-23rd century, after the corporate wars over the solar system have ended, a squad of elite mercenaries is sent on a secret mission to seize a hidden scientific-industrial base on Pluto, without knowing at first who -- or what -- they are really up against.

zpevozar.blurb: In a persecuted-minority dystopia, a village girl with a forbidden telepathic 'songlight' ability and a government official's daughter are drawn together across a war against those the state calls 'unhuman'.
zpevozar.pitch: Lark has a forbidden telepathic gift in a state that hunts people like her, and she is drawn toward a government official's daughter as war spreads. Starred reviews praise the weight of what it is about: state oppression, hiding who you are, and who gets to decide what happens to women's bodies. The story keeps Lark at its centre.

zverolekar-a-spol.blurb: Veterinarian Luke Gamble recounts anecdotes from his early career at a Dorset mixed practice, covering farm-animal work, the 2001 foot-and-mouth outbreak, and his courtship of a fellow vet, with names and details altered from the real events.

besnici-priboj.blurb: Now an MP splitting his time between Cornwall and London, Ross Poldark is drawn back into collision with his rival George Warleggan over the child Elizabeth is carrying, while Demelza becomes the target of a cruel wager at a London party and the couple works to repair their own marriage.
besnici-priboj.pitch: Ross Poldark is now an MP dividing his time between Cornwall and London, and his old rivalry with George Warleggan flares again while he and Demelza work to repair their marriage. The book runs on motive: what Ross, George and Demelza each want and why. It sits inside a larger political and family saga that also holds the Morwenna and Drake romance.

ctyri-posledni-veci.blurb: After betraying the Redeemers and returning to them, Cale is told by the order's leader that mankind must be destroyed to correct God's greatest mistake. He outwardly makes peace with his role as the angel of death, wielding both religious fervor and the Redeemers' military might.

devet-dni.blurb: Elite soldier Lee Parker is sent to capture and deliver the rebel Sera to the Citadel alive, but when their escape from a killing storm strands them together in the wilderness for nine days, both are changed by it.

devet-noci.blurb: With the immediate threat past, Sera and Lee try to build the lives they dreamed of, but the Citadel's dictatorship grows harsher and an energy-starved Blok drifts toward the same brutal tactics as its enemies.

ember-a-buraceni-draku.blurb: After saving a strange magical creature, young Ember Spark becomes an apprentice vet to magical beasts and must race to save a baby dragon before a scheming villain exposes the secret magical world.

ember-a-snezny-fenix.blurb: Ember and Arno follow a baby frost phoenix north to the Arctic and discover that the migrating neverwhales are in danger, with their old enemy once again on their trail.

grandhotel-schwarzenberg.blurb: In 1928, Anna Schwarzenberg has rebuilt her life after earlier hardship, but her son Karl's dream of building a mountain hotel and his choice of fiancee divide the family just as the Nazis begin tightening their grip on public life.

jeremy-poldark.blurb: Grieving the death of his infant daughter, Ross Poldark stands trial for inciting impoverished locals to loot a shipwreck, while Demelza works to save both her husband and their strained marriage; the book ends with the birth of their son Jeremy.
jeremy-poldark.pitch: This is grief and marriage rather than plot: Ross is carrying the loss of his infant daughter, and his trial puts his life and his marriage to Demelza under pressure at the same time. He acts from sorrow and a sense of injustice, not villainy, which makes him a flawed man you stay with. Historical drama driven by what people want and what they cannot say.

jmena.blurb: In 1987, Cora goes to register her newborn son's name while dreading her abusive husband Gordon's insistence the boy be named after him; three parallel versions of the next 35 years unfold from the single choice she makes that day.
jmena.pitch: In 1987 Cora goes to register her newborn son's name, dreading that her husband Gordon will insist the boy be named after him. Three versions of the next thirty-five years unfold from the one choice she makes that day, each fully lived. Readers call it deeply compassionate, startlingly joyful and paced like a thriller.

kroniky-nezmapovanych-kralovstvi.blurb: Squabbling twins Fox and Fibber are swept into the magical kingdom of Jungledrop, where they must find the legendary Forever Fern before the power-hungry harpy Morg destroys both worlds.

ledova-kolebka.blurb: On the world of Urth, four unlikely companions race across a frozen wasteland to find the lost capital of a vanished civilization before the falling moon destroys everyone.

nezdolna.blurb: Sara Grey has spent ten years since her father's murder hiding a growing supernatural power from everyone she loves, until a chance encounter reveals she is one of the Mohiri, an ancient race of demon hunters.

odyssey-one.blurb: Captain Eric Weston and the crew of the NAC ship Odyssey, on humanity's first deep-space mission, are drawn into a local war between two alien species and must decide whether to intervene beyond their authority.

otrocka-krasa.blurb: Hanka has had a glowing gem set into her skin as a beauty mark; the unicorns around her stop speaking to her and the dragons react with alarm. Follows on directly from Pruvodce ztracenych.

pamet-kosti.blurb: Jamie Fraser, fighting on the losing side of his convictions in the American Revolution, comes face to face with the illegitimate son who serves as a British officer, while Claire's family two centuries later uncovers the story through letters.

pekelne-zvony.blurb: Samuel Johnson and his dachshund Boswell are pulled into Hell by the vengeful demon Mrs Abernathy, who wants payback for the failed invasion of the first book.

pet-nedel-v-balonu.blurb: Dr. Ferguson, a hunter friend and a comic manservant attempt to cross Africa from Zanzibar to Senegal in a specially designed balloon, surviving a run of narrow escapes along the way.

posledni-smrtelne-pouto.blurb: The trilogy's finale: the empire is consumed by war as the ancient, near-extinct Csestriim return to finish their purge of humanity, while gods walk the earth in human guise pursuing their own agendas.
posledni-smrtelne-pouto.pitch: The empire is consumed by war as the Csestriim, the ancient near-extinct race whose evil reads as the absence of human motive, return to finish their purge of humanity, and gods walk the earth in human guise. In this closing volume gods and Csestriim both act openly, paying off the trilogy's central idea of understanding the alien other.

pruvodce-ztracenych.blurb: At a school called Airbowan, on the border between life and death and taught by harpies, twins Tom and Sam face trials as Tom tries to save Sam's soul and reunite it with his body against dark forces.

ptaci-vodopady.blurb: A WWI veteran returns to his family's African land to find it seized and his grandfather dead, and is drawn into General Sean Courtney's violent feud with his corrupt son Dirk.

samotarka.blurb: Sara Grey, having fled the Mohiri stronghold with Jordan, sets out to find the one person who can answer her questions about her past, gaining new allies and growing powers along the way.

stitch.blurb: When robots kidnap Stitch, Lilo sets out to find him - but Stitch has already escaped and will do anything, even flee to the ends of the world, to protect his new family.

theatre-macabre.blurb: In a city where the bored aristocracy is entertained by a traveling troupe of deviants, a captain of the guard hunts a mutilated-body killer while a legendary hunter of people arrives with his own agenda.

vonava-lekarna.blurb: When the magic powder Meteor is stolen, Lucie and her friends chase the thief to Amsterdam to save her friend's father from a curse-scent.

zacatek-nove-ery.blurb: In 1919 Hamburg, midwifery trainee Henny and three friends -- rebellious Kathe, wealthy Ida, and independent teacher Lina -- build a lifelong bond that carries them through the interwar years, the rise of the Nazis, and the Second World War.

zlodejicek-z-patych-hradeb.blurb: Now seventeen, Hanka unexpectedly meets the nanny she doesn't remember, who claims that Hanka's father, believed dead, is actually alive.

atlasuv-komplex.blurb: The six surviving initiates of the Alexandrian Society, bound by a deadly bargain they have failed to satisfy, turn against each other as their patron's true plan for their power comes to a head.

dva-roky-prazdnin.blurb: A schooner carrying a group of British, French and American schoolboys is swept out to sea in a storm and wrecked on an uninhabited Pacific island, where the boys must govern and provision themselves for two years until rescue.
dva-roky-prazdnin.pitch: A schooner of British, French and American schoolboys is wrecked on an uninhabited Pacific island, where they must govern and provision themselves for two years. Verne states his aim in the preface: to show what children's intelligence and courage can do under real adversity without the group sliding into savagery. They argue over leadership and split into rival camps over a cheating accusation.

posledni-den.blurb: Two years after an EMP attack devastated the United States, John Matherson's small Black Mountain community must resist a new, authoritarian federal government moving to cede US territory abroad.

aliance-udatnych.blurb: Seventh-grader Tomas, alias Skrcek, is more confident battling monsters in the video game Aliance udatnych than facing two bullies at school - until the real and virtual worlds start to merge.

arena.blurb: In Rome under Emperor Claudius, a soldier is ordered to train a young, inexperienced recruit to survive the arena against a champion gladiator who has already beaten the empire's best fighters.

barva-nachu.blurb: Celie, an abused and uneducated Black woman in the early-20th-century rural South, endures a forced marriage until her husband's mistress, the blues singer Shug Avery, becomes her friend, lover, and the catalyst for her independence.

bezuzdna-blahoslavenstvi-baltazara-b.blurb: A picaresque following the wealthy, neglected Balthazar B from a Parisian childhood through English boarding school and Trinity College Dublin, tracking his friendship with the roguish Beefy and a string of romantic and sexual entanglements along the way.

bili-havrani.blurb: In a fictional medieval kingdom, a scheming regent seizes power after the king's death and plots to force the orphaned princess into marriage, driving the prince and princess to flee and fight for the throne.

bourlive-ticho.blurb: Trying to settle back into an ordinary home after their coastal walk, the author struggles with fear of people and the future while her husband's illness continues to progress, until an unexpected act of generosity gives them a new place to live.

bratri-ve-zbrani.blurb: In Rome, the imperial secretary's men capture a messenger for dangerous conspirators and torture out of him a plot to derail the Roman campaign against Caratacus, leader of the British tribes still resisting Rome.

carojas.blurb: An orphan forced to work in a cruel orphanage's match factory rescues an abandoned fairy child, escapes with help from the boy's tiny forest-guardian family, and returns to free the other orphans.
carojas.pitch: An orphan enslaved in a cruel matron's match factory rescues an abandoned fairy baby and chooses not to stay safe. It is a rescuer's story: a child who is defined by what he wants to do for others. The book won The Times' children's book of the year, and it has the craft to show for it.

cas-mezi-nami.blurb: A teenage girl in 1995 Illinois and a time-traveling teenage boy from 2012 fall in love, knowing he could be pulled back to his own time without warning.

cena-za-krale.blurb: In 1647, with the English Civil War's outcome undecided and the King under house arrest, Tom Neave must balance his loyalty to a divided Parliament against his estranged Royalist father and the safety of his own young family.

cerna-labut.blurb: A nonfiction argument that rare, unpredictable, high-impact events ("black swans") shape history and markets far more than the models we use to plan for them admit, illustrated through finance, history and the nature of hindsight bias.
cerna-labut.pitch: One idea laid out precisely and tested across finance, history and everyday reasoning: rare, unpredictable events shape the world, then get explained away as obvious afterwards. Taleb turns the same rigour on financial and historical certainty. Nonfiction with no protagonist, carried entirely by the argument.

daleka-cesta.blurb: In 1939, an affluent Jewish family in Czechoslovakia flees the German occupation with their six-year-old son and his nanny, who is drawn into an affair with a Nazi collaborator that threatens the family's escape.
daleka-cesta.pitch: In 1939 an affluent Jewish family flees occupied Czechoslovakia with their six-year-old son and his nanny. The book centres on what each person is willing to risk to save the boy. Booker-longlisted and personally researched by Alison Pick, it keeps you inside the loyalty, fear and guilt of the escape.

darwinsky-vytah.blurb: In the 23rd century, an alien-built space elevator in Darwin, Australia is the only safe zone left on a virus-ravaged Earth; an immune scavenger and his crew get caught in a power struggle over the elevator's future.
darwinsky-vytah.pitch: In the 23rd century an alien-built space elevator in Darwin, Australia is the only safe zone on a virus-ravaged Earth, and an immune scavenger and his crew get caught in a power struggle over its future. The logistics are laid out in real detail: food grown on the stations, water and air brought up from the ground, and a whole society tipping toward anarchy when the elevator falters.

dejiny-ruska-20-stoleti.blurb: A two-volume academic history of Russia from the fall of tsarism through 2007, written by a team of Russian historians led by Andrej Zubov, examining why post-tsarist Russia's path led to a modernizing but totalitarian regime.

den-cisaru.blurb: Back from campaign in Hispania, Cato and Macro want to return to ordinary soldiering, but rival factions fighting for control over Rome force Cato to play a dangerous game to survive, trusting only Macro.

denik-1938-1945.blurb: A diary kept by a Jewish girl in Prague and then Terezin and Auschwitz between the ages of ten and fourteen, later expanded with retrospective sections and an interview after she reclaimed the notebooks hidden by her uncle.

divka-v-podivne-zemi.blurb: Sophia has spent her whole life in a valley community sealed off from a world she is told is ravaged by war. When her friend Mirko disappears over the mountains, she follows him and discovers a highly advanced society instead of a battlefield.

dlouha-valka.blurb: Direct continuation of Dlouha zeme: humanity has spread across countless parallel Earths connected by airship trade routes, but as people try to adapt the Long Earth to themselves, the Long Earth adapts them back, and tensions boil over into crisis.

dlouha-zeme.blurb: An eccentric inventor publishes plans for a simple homemade device that lets anyone 'step' into an endless chain of parallel, uninhabited Earths; drifter Joshua Valiente, who can step without the device, sets out with the AI Lobsang to explore how far the Long Earth goes.
dlouha-zeme.pitch: An eccentric inventor publishes plans for a stepping device made of simple wiring and a potato, and anyone can step into an endless chain of uninhabited parallel Earths. The book follows the concrete consequences: who controls access, how a species reacts to an open frontier, a spacefaring nation like Kenya taking the lead. Joshua Valiente, who can step without the device, sets out with the AI Lobsang to see how far it goes.

dym-nad-brezinkou.blurb: A political prisoner's account of nearly three years at Auschwitz-Birkenau, written in a distinctive third-person documentary style intended to represent the collective fate of the camp's prisoners rather than a single personal voice.
dym-nad-brezinkou.pitch: Szmaglewska's account of nearly three years as a political prisoner at Auschwitz-Birkenau, written straight after the war and later entered as evidence at Nuremberg. She writes as the prisoner rather than I, deliberately representing hundreds of thousands, and it is as thorough an examination of what actually happened as testimony gets.

fackovani-andele.blurb: A biographically-toned account of the author's personal and often painful experiences from the 1950s to the present, set against the political and social changes of Czechoslovakia and the Czech Republic.

hora-v-mori.blurb: A marine biologist is invited by a secretive tech corporation to study a newly discovered species of hyper-intelligent octopus on a sealed-off archipelago, while an AI-crewed fishing vessel and a corporate-built android pursue parallel questions about machine consciousness.
hora-v-mori.pitch: A marine biologist is invited to a sealed-off archipelago to study a newly discovered species of hyper-intelligent octopus, while an AI-crewed fishing vessel and a corporate-built android pursue questions about machine minds in parallel. It follows the consequences of non-human and machine intelligence with rigour, and it won the Locus Award and reached the Nebula, Clarke and Bradbury shortlists.

hra-o-manzelstvi.blurb: At Brown University in the early 1980s, English major Madeleine Hanna falls into an intense relationship with the brilliant, troubled Leonard while her devoted friend Mitchell searches for meaning abroad, and the three navigate love, mental illness and faith into the years after graduation.
hra-o-manzelstvi.pitch: Brown University, early eighties: Madeleine reads Barthes on love while living a love triangle with brilliant, troubled Leonard and her devoted friend Mitchell, who goes searching for faith in Calcutta. A novel built on what its three leads want and why, and on whether the old marriage plot can still work in a modern, secular, medicated world.

invictus.blurb: Mid-first-century Rome under Claudius continues to expand. After hard fighting in Britain, the inseparable Prefect Cato and Centurion Macro are sent to Hispania, which refuses to submit.

jazyk-draku.blurb: In an alternate 1923 London where dragons and humans are bound by an unequal Peace Agreement, a rule-abiding translation student accidentally triggers a civil war and takes a dangerous code-breaking job to save her arrested family.
jazyk-draku.pitch: In a London of 1923 ruled by a human-dragon treaty and rigid class lines, Viv, who has always followed the rules, ends up in code-breaking work to save her family. Love for her sister drives her, and the book will not let you cheer for just one side: who is the real monster, the dragon or the system that exploits it?

kdyz-panda-tanci.blurb: After his wife's death in a car accident leaves their young son unable to speak and he loses his job, a struggling father takes up busking in a worn panda costume in the local park - and becomes the only one who can reach his traumatized son, who doesn't know the panda is his own father.
kdyz-panda-tanci.pitch: A widowed, jobless father puts on a battered panda costume to busk in the park, and in it becomes the one person his silent son will let near. It is a very particular kind of indirect closeness: a father reaching his boy without saying who he is. Readers describe it as comedy and grief working together, a comedy of sadness and dancing bears.

klic-k-rebece.blurb: Cairo, 1942: Nazi spy Alex Wolff feeds Rommel's advancing army British intelligence using a code keyed to Daphne du Maurier's Rebecca, while British officer William Vandam races to catch him with the help of a courtesan he recruits to get close to Wolff.

kluci-z-glasgow.blurb: Two young men who were close as boys in the Scottish foster care system, now estranged, separately try to build stable adult lives - one training as a nurse, one newly settled with foster parents - while carrying the trauma of the care system and wondering whether to reconnect.
kluci-z-glasgow.pitch: Finlay and Banjo grew up together in Scottish foster care and have drifted apart. Finlay is training as a nurse and Banjo has just settled with foster parents, each trying to build a stable life and wondering whether to reconnect. Their chapters have distinct voices, and both are drawn so sympathetically that you want to scream at the injustices done to them. It won the Carnegie Medal and the Branford Boase Award for a debut.

knihovnik-a-malirka-casu.blurb: A young artist travels to a sleepy Korean town to claim an inheritance and finds a deck of hand-painted fortune cards, a mysterious cafe owner, and a temple hiding a legend that becomes the key to traveling through time.
knihovnik-a-malirka-casu.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

kobky-pod-potalou.blurb: In 1968, Red Guards occupy Tibet's Potala Palace and imprison the Dalai Lama's former court painter, who recalls his life devoted to sacred art while they work to destroy every trace of it.

kruan-ze-zlute-planety.blurb: An omnibus collecting a classic Czech science-fiction adventure comic strip, following the character Kruan across two serialized trilogies of episodic adventures.

krvavi-havrani.blurb: Rome's grip on Britain is being tested by the fanatical resistance leader Caratacus, who has already worn the legions down. Two of the army's most experienced soldiers return to the province after years away.

kukuricny-mesto.blurb: Sixteen-year-old Austin records in obsessive detail how he and his best friend Robby accidentally unleash an unstoppable army of giant praying mantises on their small Iowa town, all while sorting out his feelings for his girlfriend and for Robby.

legie.blurb: A former gladiator turned rebel leader, who already caused huge damage during a slave uprising, is fleeing justice and still threatening Rome's stability; Cato and Macro are sent after him, with personal scores of their own to settle.

leonard-a-hladovy-paul.blurb: Two solitary, unremarkable men in their thirties - one a children's-encyclopedia writer newly grieving his mother, one a substitute postman living with his parents - navigate ordinary life: a sister's wedding, a workplace competition, and a tentative romance, largely without conflict.
leonard-a-hladovy-paul.pitch: Two ordinary men in their thirties, an encyclopedia writer and a substitute postman, move through quiet days: a wedding, a slogan-writing contest, a tentative romance. The book spends its attention on kindness and small resolutions, and trusts you to know their happiness is never in doubt. Gentle, voice-driven, and about what ordinary kindness is worth.

maxmilian.blurb: In an alternate 19th-century Austria-Hungary where an assassination attempt on Franz Josef I succeeded, his brother Maximilian rules as emperor and has just defeated France and Italy in the north, now facing pressure from Prussia to keep Austria's place in the German Confederation.

mazel.blurb: In a city that insists its monsters are gone, a girl and a creature that climbs out of her mother's painting hunt down a real danger hidden inside a trusted household.
mazel.pitch: Jam hardly speaks aloud, and she pulls a monster called Pet out of her mother's painting to hunt for a real danger hidden inside a trusted family. The book's argument is that danger comes from the people a community refuses to see as dangerous, and Jam is no bystander: she goes after the truth herself.

mezi-vilami.blurb: A multigenerational saga following the Boyle family of Dublin from the late 1950s to 2002, tracking ambition, thwarted expectation, and the changing shape of Ireland through parents Declan and Sinead and their children Owen and Issie.
mezi-vilami.pitch: A Dublin family followed through seven snapshot chapters from the end of the fifties into the new century, each one built around what a different Boyle wants: Declan's ambition against his sense of duty, Sinead wondering whether she is allowed ambitions at all, Issie's choices. The change of Irish society runs quietly behind them.

mnoho-smrti-laily-starr.blurb: The goddess of death is fired from her post when a baby is born who will one day discover immortality, and is reincarnated as a mortal woman who repeatedly dies while deciding whether to kill the child.
mnoho-smrti-laily-starr.pitch: Death, fired from her post, is reborn as a mortal woman and dies and returns again and again while she decides whether to kill the child who will discover immortality. The idea reviewers single out is that death gives life its shape, explored across several short, self-contained cycles.

murodejka.blurb: A young apprentice tasked with tending her desert village's sacred moon-moths struggles with the isolation of the job and what it costs her friendships.

na-hrane-koule.blurb: A girl named Eliska grows from childhood into adolescence believing she has already lived through everything and has nothing left to lose, while the adults and institutions around her repeatedly fail her.

na-vetrne-hurce.blurb: Heathcliff, an orphan taken in by the Earnshaw family, and Catherine grow up devoted to each other, but when she marries a neighboring landowner instead, his consuming resentment reshapes both families across two generations.

nadeje-umira-posledni.blurb: A Polish-Jewish woman's autobiographical account of surviving the Warsaw ghetto and the Majdanek, Auschwitz, Ravensbruck and Neustadt-Glewe camps as a teenager, written as an adult roughly two decades later.
nadeje-umira-posledni.pitch: Halina Birenbaum survived the Warsaw ghetto and several camps as a teenager, and wrote this as an adult some twenty years later. The distance matters: it is a considered retrospective on what happened and why, an insider account that gives real understanding of lived experience.

nebe-v-plamenech.blurb: A woman who has survived alone in the jungle for years is pulled into a heist against a tyrannical dragon regent's hoard, and finds herself drawn into the politics and romance of the dragon-ruled cloud cities.
