nebe-v-plamenech.pitch: Anahrod, a survivalist raised outside dragon-ruled society, is pulled into a heist against a hostile dragon regent's hoard. Reviewers consistently single out the worldbuilding, a society genuinely reorganised around dragon power, and a protagonist whose growth is tracked closely. The dragons' magic is innate to the species, and the cloud cities have politics of their own.

nebezpecne-krasny.blurb: A teenage girl who has always been able to see invisible faeries is pursued by the Summer King, who believes she is the queen he has sought for centuries.

neobycejna-grace.blurb: A woman in the middle of a divorce and still grieving a family tragedy abandons her car in traffic and sets off across London with a cake, determined to reach her estranged sixteen-year-old daughter on her birthday.

orlova-korist.blurb: More than a year after the Roman invasion of Britain, the local war leader Caratacus keeps making life hard for the legions, and Emperor Claudius needs a clear victory to shore up his rule at home.

pirati.blurb: A young sailor, Telemachos, survives a pirate attack on his ship and is forced into a brutal choice: join the pirate crew or die, then must prove himself among a mutinous band.

plants-vs-zombies.blurb: Nate, Patrice and the inventor Crazy Dave repeatedly face Dr. Zomboss and his zombie armies, including a scheme that sends the fight across the past, present and future.

po-stezkach.blurb: The author and her husband Moth undertake a roughly 1,000-mile walk from Cape Wrath in Scotland's far north down through the highlands and on to the South West Coast Path, hoping the outdoors will again ease his declining health.

pobrezni-cesta.blurb: After losing their home and learning that her husband Moth has been diagnosed with a rare terminal illness, the author and Moth set off with almost nothing to walk the 630-mile South West Coast Path.

pohansky-pan.blurb: Estranged from his family and outlawed by the Church, Uhtred of Bebbanburg leads a band of outcasts north in a bid to retake his family's fortress while a Danish warlord threatens Wessex.

pohlednice.blurb: An anonymous postcard naming four relatives killed at Auschwitz prompts the author to reconstruct her Jewish family's history and, years later, to investigate who sent it.
pohlednice.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)
pohlednice.pitch: An anonymous postcard arrives naming four relatives killed at Auschwitz, and Anne Berest sets out to reconstruct her great-grandparents' flight from Russia through Latvia, Palestine and Paris. Years later she investigates who sent it. Readers single out its attention to survivors' aftermath and guilt, and it shows how antisemitism was enforced administratively under Vichy.

posledni-hodina.blurb: Roman general Marcus Clodius Ballista learns of a plot to assassinate Emperor Gallienus as he leaves the Colosseum in twenty-four hours, and must evade the conspirators hunting him while racing to warn the emperor in time.

posledni-ukol-mabel-beaumontove.blurb: After her husband of sixty years dies, an 86-year-old widow finds a note from him reading only "Find D" and sets out to track down Dot, the childhood best friend and first love she lost touch with decades earlier under the social pressure of the 1950s.

pretorian.blurb: Rome in 50 AD is riven with plots and a dangerous grain shortage that threatens to spark riots. Conspirators calling themselves the Liberators pose the gravest threat yet to Emperor Claudius.

prodam-2-deti.blurb: During the Great Depression, a struggling reporter's staged photograph of two children with a 'for sale' sign launches his career - and when a real mother sells her own children after his story runs, he and a colleague set out to find and reunite the family.
prodam-2-deti.pitch: A Depression-era reporter stages a photograph of two children with a for-sale sign to launch his career, and when a real mother sells her own children after his story runs, he and a colleague set out to find and reunite the family. The idea is the cost of a media fabrication: a staged lie with real consequences.

propast-casu.blurb: In a world where history has fractured and reassembled into a patchwork of colliding eras, two rival empires - a British Empire from 1900 and a Roman Empire led by the story's heroine - struggle for control of the new Europe this collision has created.

ptacatko.blurb: In a future Canada at war with an American theocracy called the New Vatican, a young Indigenous girl whose mother was taken by the enemy becomes the reluctant face of a rebellion.

pteranodon.blurb: A factual, comic-style recreation of a Pteranodon's life, showing it hunting fish at sea while avoiding sea monsters and land predators, based on fossil evidence.

rebelske-srdce.blurb: In Budapest on the eve of the 1956 revolution, a young woman whose parents were executed by the secret police must decide whether to flee the country or fight for recognition of the injustice done to her family, aided by a magical river and an angel of death.
rebelske-srdce.pitch: Budapest on the eve of the 1956 revolution: Csilla's parents were executed as traitors and then exonerated, and she must choose between fleeing and demanding that the injustice be acknowledged. The book asks what it costs to be seen after your family has been erased, and reviewers repeatedly call her a lead worth cheering for.

regaci-a-neznami-hrdinove-odboje.blurb: Four young friends whose parents work in the emergency-rescue services face bullying, a dangerous rafting accident, and peer pressure at school, while also hearing the stories of lesser-known heroes of the WWII resistance.
regaci-a-neznami-hrdinove-odboje.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

rezave-panny.blurb: In the summer of 1980, Phoebe Shaw watches the girls of her declining Cleveland neighborhood transform - their bones corroding like rusted metal - while she alone remains unchanged, and returns decades later to confront what happened.

rimska-cest.blurb: Fifteen years after the invasion of Britain, Centurion Macro leaves the legion to help his mother run an inn in Londinium and manage the land granted to him as a veteran.

rimska-krev.blurb: Cato and Macro escort the ruthless king Rhadamistus back to the Armenian throne, a client Rome would rather tolerate than lose to Parthia, over the objections of Armenians who preferred the man he displaced.

ritual.blurb: In a world where magic is part of everyday life, four girls approaching their sixteenth birthdays investigate the secretive coming-of-age Rite that will decide who they become.

robin-druhy-a-jeho-rodina.blurb: A large family living together in one house, along with several dogs adopted by the two young daughters, gets into constant comic scrapes while renovating their home, told with warmth and humor.
robin-druhy-a-jeho-rodina.pitch: A comic Czech family chronicle: a large family and their dogs, several adopted by the two young daughters, in constant scrapes while renovating their home. It is told with warmth and humor, carried by voice and an ensemble of distinct characters rather than by an idea, and readers who return to it report a consistently warm reception.

sadako-sasaki-a-tisic-papirovych-jerabu.blurb: A biography of Sadako Sasaki, a Hiroshima survivor who developed leukemia a decade after the atomic bombing and folded paper cranes while hoping to recover, told for the first time by her older brother Masahiro alongside co-author Sue DiCicco.
sadako-sasaki-a-tisic-papirovych-jerabu.pitch: Written by Sadako's own older brother with a co-author, to put right the contradictory, incomplete versions that had circulated, this is an insider account of a Hiroshima survivor's life and of the long tail of radiation sickness. It reads as a calm adult retrospective, with a paper-crane craft guide at the back.

sberatel-dymek.blurb: Ten short stories, each unspooling from a pipe washed up by a cold tide in the Dead Man's Fjord, carrying the reader from the Tsarist court to Siberia, pre-war Berlin, Brazilian favelas and Berber lands, with characters from Kettu's earlier novel and historical figures recurring across them.
sberatel-dymek.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

sharpova-pomsta.blurb: In the chaotic peace after Napoleon's exile to Elba, Richard Sharpe is framed for stealing the Emperor's treasury and must clear his name while his estranged wife schemes against him at home.
sharpova-pomsta.pitch: Richard Sharpe is framed for stealing Napoleon's treasury in the chaotic peace after Elba and has to clear his name. Sharpe is a working-class outsider who rises on competence, with a clear code about the right and wrong times to kill. Because he knows his enemy almost at once, it reads as a revenge chase rather than a whodunit.

silnejsi-nez-smrt.blurb: Three childhood friends in Rome - an aspiring novelist, a champion cyclist, and a Jewish mathematics prodigy - are pulled apart by Mussolini's fascism and the Nazi occupation, and a decades-old paternity secret reveals how their fates were decided.
silnejsi-nez-smrt.pitch: Three childhood friends in Rome, each wanting something different, are forced to act on it as fascism and the Nazi occupation close in. You follow Elisabetta's hunger to become a writer and the two men who love her, while their families are pulled toward collaboration or persecution. It is grounded in the real, well-researched 1943 roundup of Rome's Jews.

sloup-do-nebe.blurb: A renegade scientist and a Ukrainian-born physicist campaign to build a space elevator as the world slides toward war over water and energy.
sloup-do-nebe.pitch: A scientist and an engineer fight political and financial obstacles to build a working space elevator as a real answer to an energy and water crisis. The idea is carried through with actual engineering consequences, hard SF with no magic at all.

smrt-cisari.blurb: The future of Roman Britain hangs by a thread: after the Iceni queen is captured, several native tribes unite in revolt, and Centurion Macro and Prefect Cato face the hardest fight of their lives.

snurari.blurb: A directionless young man who inexplicably carries fragments of knowledge from other lives is kidnapped by an alien bounty hunter and pulled into a hunt across warring alien factions, with his best friend along for the ride.
snurari.pitch: Ben works at a bait shop and knows trivia he cannot explain, and then an alien bounty hunter tells him why. Reviewers single out the friendship between Ben and his best friend Patton as the real heart of the book, with genuine warmth and stakes when the pair are captured together. It is comic SF that gives you a real answer in the end.

spodek.blurb: A schizophrenic sixteen-year-old escapes a psychiatric hospital and descends into the New York subway system, pursued by his mother and a police detective, convinced he must find a girl from his past to prevent the end of the world.
spodek.pitch: Sixteen-year-old Will walks out of a psychiatric hospital into the New York subway, convinced he must find a girl from his past to stop the end of the world. Almost the whole book is spent on what he wants and why, and readers with clinical familiarity single out how thoroughly researched and internally consistent his psychosis is. His mother and a detective pursue him in parallel chapters.

star-wars.blurb: Three short stories set after the Battle of Endor: Luke Skywalker defends the New Republic from a mercenary gang, Han Solo investigates a deadly underworld mystery, and Leia Organa confronts a new alliance opposed to the Republic's goals.

stin-legendy.blurb: Decades into a war against an alien enemy, Earth has become a vast military-industrial complex ringed by satellite cities; agent John Francis Kovar is sent to confirm the existence of a weapon that threatens the wider metauniverse.

sto-roku-lenni-a-margot.blurb: On the terminal ward of a Glasgow hospital, 17-year-old Lenni befriends 83-year-old Margot, and together the two decide to paint one hundred pictures marking the combined hundred years of their lives, trading their stories as they go.
sto-roku-lenni-a-margot.pitch: Seventeen-year-old Lenni and eighty-three-year-old Margot meet on a hospital ward and decide to paint one hundred pictures, one for each year of their combined lives, telling their stories as they go. Readers say Lenni herself is the reason it works. Margot is more than a device: she is the friendship the book is about.

strasliva-zavrat.blurb: Five linked, fact-blended stories about real 20th-century scientists - Heisenberg, Schrodinger, Grothendieck, Haber, Einstein - whose breakthroughs carried them to the edge of madness and gave humanity the power to destroy itself.

sudety-ztraceny-raj.blurb: Ten short stories from leading contemporary Czech writers, set in the multi-ethnic Sudeten borderlands before the events of the Second World War and the postwar expulsion of the German population irrevocably changed the region.
sudety-ztraceny-raj.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

syn-draka.blurb: In 1477, rumors spread that Vlad III Dracula did not die but returned as a vampire seeking revenge on those who killed him, drawing the Ottoman and Hungarian courts into the conflict.

tajemstvi-modrych-tresni.blurb: In a post-apocalyptic future where every child sickens with permanent exhaustion on reaching adolescence, an unheroic girl and her nervous monkey navigator journey into a mutant-filled wasteland in search of a rumoured cure.

tehotnej-buddha.blurb: A Czech mother's first-person account of a stillbirth and the high-risk pregnancy that followed, confronting the social taboo around infant loss and the medical system's lack of empathy with dark humor.
tehotnej-buddha.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)
tehotnej-buddha.pitch: A Czech blogger's first-person account of a stillbirth and the high-risk pregnancy that followed, written to break the taboo around losing a child. Her voice is blunt, funny and unsentimental, with each chapter opened by a fantasy-novel quote, and she is shaken most by the coldness of the medical system. It gives real insight into an experience most people avoid thinking about, as Seeking Allah, Finding Jesus did.

ten-cerny-vzadu.blurb: Shakespeare's Othello is transposed to a single day at a 1970s Washington-area elementary school, where the new boy Osei's budding friendship with the school's most popular girl draws the jealous scheming of a classmate determined to destroy it.
ten-cerny-vzadu.pitch: Othello, moved to a single day in a 1970s American schoolyard. A new boy, Osei, finds an instant friendship with the most popular girl in school, and a classmate sets out to wreck it. The characters map cleanly onto the play, and reviews single out Osei as a standout with a real arc, in an adult look at racism told through eleven-year-olds.

tymian-z-oxary.blurb: A girl is pulled into an unfinished undersea storybook world after its author dies, and must help restore order before chaos and evil take over.

ve-vterine.blurb: Sixteen-year-old Finn Miller dies in a car accident and is suspended between life and death, watching helplessly as her family and friends struggle to survive its aftermath.

vyhnanstvi.blurb: Emperor Nero's advisers push him to send his lover, a former slave, into exile on Sardinia to defuse a political threat. Cato, out of favour after leaving the Praetorian Guard, is given the job of escorting her there and a second task besides.

vykopavky.blurb: In the summer of 1939, widow Edith Pretty hires self-taught excavator Basil Brown to dig the burial mounds on her Suffolk property, uncovering an Anglo-Saxon ship burial as war approaches, told through the shifting perspectives of Pretty, Brown, and the young archaeologist Peggy Piggott.
vykopavky.pitch: Summer, the eve of war: a widow hires a self-taught excavator to open the burial mounds on her Suffolk land, and the dig turns into one of the great discoveries in English archaeology. Edith, Basil and the young archaeologist Peggy each want something different from it, and the book moves between their eyes.

vzkaz-na-zdi-zachodku.blurb: A teenager newly diagnosed with schizophrenia starts an experimental drug that suppresses his hallucinations so he can appear normal at a new school, where he falls for a girl who doesn't know his secret - until the drug starts to fail.
vzkaz-na-zdi-zachodku.pitch: Adam, newly diagnosed with schizophrenia, starts an experimental drug so he can pass as normal at a new school and be near a girl he likes. You are inside his head all the way, and nearly every scene comes back to one wish: to be seen as Adam, not as a diagnosis. A reviewer calls him hilarious and infinitely lovable.

zariva-noc-hvezd-a-ledu.blurb: Alternating between Captain Arthur Rostron racing the Carpathia toward Titanic's distress call and third-class survivor Kate Connolly in a lifeboat, the novel follows a single night's rescue based on the true story.
zariva-noc-hvezd-a-ledu.pitch: Alternating between Captain Arthur Rostron racing the Carpathia toward the Titanic's distress call and third-class survivor Kate Connolly in a lifeboat, the novel follows a single night's rescue, based on the true story. Reviewers praise it repeatedly for its pace and for its grounding in real events.

zil-jsem-mezi-malomocnymi.blurb: A journalist sentenced to prison for bank fraud discovers his facility shares grounds with America's last leper colony, and forms unlikely friendships with the stigmatized patients living there.
zil-jsem-mezi-malomocnymi.pitch: A man serving time for fraud lands in a prison that shares its grounds with America's last leprosy colony, and what grows there is friendship. Ella Bounds, sent away from her own family as a girl for having a disease rather than committing a crime, is one of the patients who open up a world most people never think about. It is a memoir about stigma, seen from inside.

zlata-sbirka-pohadek.blurb: Wendy and her brothers meet Peter Pan and fly with him to Neverland, discovering the Lost Boys' hideout and battling Captain Hook's pirates, in this Disney retelling of J. M. Barrie's story.
zlata-sbirka-pohadek.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

zpoved-lisaka.blurb: A present-day trans academic discovers a manuscript claiming to be the lost autobiography of 18th-century thief and jailbreaker Jack Sheppard and his lover Bess; as he annotates it, the line between the historical narrative and his own footnotes breaks down.

zradcove-rima.blurb: Rome prepares for war with Parthia but is not ready to fight until winter, so General Corbulo sends Cato to negotiate a peace the Parthian king cannot accept, buying time for the legions to muster.

1356.blurb: Mercenary captain Thomas of Hookton is ordered to recover a relic said to guarantee victory in battle before joining the Black Prince's campaign that culminates at the Battle of Poitiers.
1356.pitch: Thomas of Hookton has an urgent task, to recover a relic said to guarantee victory, while a rival churchman hunts the same prize for his own ambition. The danger lies in what men believe about the relic, not in any magic it performs. Reviewers single out the climactic Battle of Poitiers as an unusually strong set piece.

mec-kralu.blurb: As the ailing King Edward of Wessex loses his grip on his heirs and followers, two rival claimants prepare to fight for the throne while Uhtred tries to keep his beloved Northumbria out of the coming war.

pisecnici-a-volani-tesakody.blurb: After 43 years of hibernation and a 24-light-year voyage, cadet Tomas and his friends wake to a new age of human space exploration, training at a space academy while Tomas becomes fixated on a mysterious alien artifact, the tesakoda.
pisecnici-a-volani-tesakody.pitch: After forty-three years of hibernation and a twenty-four-light-year voyage, cadet Tomas and his friends wake to a new age of space exploration and train at a space academy, while Tomas becomes fixated on a mysterious alien artifact. By a Magnesia Litera-winning author, warmly reviewed as accessible for roughly ages eleven to fifteen, with an interesting idea and a well thought-out story. Readers compare the cadet training to Ender's Game.

pisen-mece.blurb: Uhtred, the Northumbrian Saxon raised among Vikings, is drawn into a fight over London as Danish raiders and Saxon lords both try to control the city.

plamenonosic.blurb: With a fragile truce holding between the Saxons and the Danes, Uhtred of Bebbanburg finally gets his chance to retake the family fortress stolen from him by his treacherous uncle.

prazdny-trun.blurb: When the ruler of Mercia dies without a male heir, Uhtred of Bebbanburg backs the dead lord's widow, Aethelflaed, in the fight over who will rule.

sharpovo-waterloo.blurb: As Napoleon marches on Brussels, Richard Sharpe tries to warn an inexperienced Dutch commander before the armies collide at Waterloo.
sharpovo-waterloo.pitch: Sharpe is trying to make an inexperienced Prince of Orange listen before the French arrive, and the book runs as one continuous campaign to Waterloo. Reviewers single this entry out for its sustained battle intensity and its pace, with Sharpe wanting one thing and refusing to let go of it.

smrt-kralu.blurb: As King Alfred's health fails, Uhtred of Bebbanburg must decide where his loyalty lies while the Danes sense an opportunity to strike at a weakened Wessex.

srsen-leta-v-noci.blurb: Nazi-occupied Denmark, 1941: a pastor's son discovers a secret German radar installation that is shooting down British bombers, and must fly a derelict biplane across the North Sea to warn the RAF before a major raid.
srsen-leta-v-noci.pitch: In occupied Denmark, eighteen-year-old Harald Olufsen discovers a secret German radar site and must get the evidence to Britain in a barely flyable biplane. One clear mission carries the book, with believable, motivated characters and tight, economical plotting. Along the way Harald joins the fledgling Danish resistance.

triceratops.blurb: A factual, comic-style recreation of a Triceratops navigating threats and dangers of its prehistoric environment, based on fossil evidence.

valecnici-boure.blurb: Uhtred of Bebbanburg must choose between family and the Saxon cause as Norse warriors threaten the fortress city of Chester.

valka-vlku.blurb: Newly restored to his family fortress, Uhtred of Bebbanburg is drawn back into the wider war as King Edward's health fails and rebellion stirs in Mercia.

ztracene-svety-2001.blurb: A collection of deleted scenes, alternate drafts, and journal entries from the four-year process of writing a famous science-fiction novel, alongside the short story that inspired it.

zaslana-posta.blurb: A condemned confidence trickster is spared the gallows on condition that he reopen Ankh-Morpork's collapsed postal service, against the semaphore company that replaced it.
zaslana-posta.pitch: Moist von Lipwig, a condemned confidence man, is offered a choice by Vetinari: reopen Ankh-Morpork's dead Post Office or step through a door with no floor. What follows is a race against a semaphore monopoly whose clacks are priced, owned and run for profit, with the plot following what a semaphore can and cannot carry. The same comic voice you liked in Mort, with an institution to rebuild.

mali-bohove.blurb: A novice in a militant church discovers that his god now has exactly one believer left, and that a god's power is the number of people who believe in him.

podivny-regiment.blurb: A girl cuts off her hair and enlists in her country's army under a false name to find her brother, in a nation whose state religion keeps adding to a list of forbidden things.
podivny-regiment.pitch: A girl cuts off her hair and enlists in her country's army under a false name to find her brother, and from the first chapter she is someone you root for. Her country is starving and at war with everyone because of a state religion that keeps adding to its list of forbidden things. Under the comedy runs a sharp look at what a nation tells itself in wartime.

nadelat-prachy.blurb: The new master of a royal mint that loses money on every coin it strikes introduces paper currency into a metal economy.
nadelat-prachy.pitch: A confidence trickster with a want and a nerve problem is handed a royal mint that loses money on every coin, and sets out to introduce paper currency into a metal economy. Out of it come a bank run, the question of what really backs a promise, and a vault that no longer holds what everyone thinks it does. Best read after the earlier volume that introduces him.

otec-prasatek.blurb: The Discworld's midwinter gift-bringer has been removed by an attack on the belief in him, and Death takes over the round while his granddaughter looks for the culprit.
otec-prasatek.pitch: The fat man who brings the midwinter presents is removed by an attack on the belief in him, and Death takes over the round to keep the sun coming up. It is the strongest idea in the Death books: you learn to believe small untruths so that you can believe the large ones a civilisation runs on. Belief works by exact rules here, and every scene keeps to them.

uzasny-mauric.blurb: A talking cat and a troop of self-aware rats run a Pied Piper confidence trick on country towns until one town turns out to have something worse in its cellars.
uzasny-mauric.pitch: A talking cat and a troop of self-aware rats run a Pied Piper confidence trick on country towns, until one town turns out to have something worse in its cellars. The rats take names and argue over a story they have inherited, and they are as differentiated as a cast of people. A children's book with a real adult layer.

pyramidy.blurb: A boy trained as an assassin is recalled to rule a river kingdom that has spent seven thousand years building pyramids, and finds out what the pyramids do to time.
pyramidy.pitch: A boy sent away to be trained as an assassin is recalled to rule a river kingdom that has spent seven thousand years building pyramids. Then he finds out what those pyramids do, and what that means for his kingdom and for a teenager suddenly made a god-king.

tezke-melodicno.blurb: A new kind of music arrives on the Discworld that is alive and plays its players, while Death's granddaughter takes over his duties.
tezke-melodicno.pitch: A new kind of music arrives on the Discworld that is alive and plays its players, while Death's granddaughter takes over his round. A good deal of it is a sustained joke about the history of rock and roll, and the voice is what you come for.

pravda-the-truth.blurb: A gentleman's son who writes a hand-copied newsletter acquires a printing press, invents the newspaper, and finds himself investigating who framed the city's ruler.
pravda-the-truth.pitch: A gentleman's son who writes a hand-copied newsletter acquires a printing press and invents the newspaper, breaking a guild's monopoly and creating a readership overnight. A rival sells made-up stories that sell better than real ones, and the question underneath is who framed the city's ruler, which the lead sets out to find.

pod-parou.blurb: A locomotive is built on the Discworld and the continent reorganises itself around the railway that follows.
pod-parou.pitch: A locomotive is built on the Discworld, and the continent reorganises itself around the railway that follows. Steam rises over a land where the new technology changes trade, war and who can reach whom: one invention and a society visibly changed by it. It opens on one engineer and one engine.

pohyblive-obrazky.blurb: A place is found where the barrier between the imagined and the real has worn thin, and a film industry grows on top of it.
pohyblive-obrazky.pitch: A place is found where the barrier between the imagined and the real has worn thin, and a film industry grows on top of it. An economy, a labour market and a hazard all follow from that one idea. The wizards and the supporting cast take much of the best material.

hrrr-na-ne.blurb: An uninhabited island surfaces between two cities and both claim it, while the Ankh-Morpork Watch commander investigates the first death of the resulting war.

magicky-prazdroj.blurb: An eighth son of an eighth son of an eighth son is born a source of raw magic, and the Discworld's wizards begin a war over it.

erik-eric.blurb: A teenage demonologist summons a demon and gets a failed wizard instead, then spends his three wishes on the Discworld's version of Faust's bargain.

zajimave-casy.blurb: A revolution in the Discworld's oldest empire is set off by a pamphlet, and a failed wizard is sent there because someone asked for a Great Wizard.

posledni-kontinent.blurb: A failed wizard is stranded on a hot, dry southern continent that has stopped raining, while a party of academics is lost at another point in time.

sekac.blurb: Death is dismissed from his post, so nothing on the Discworld dies properly and the unclaimed life force has to go somewhere.
sekac.pitch: Death is dismissed from his post, so nothing on the Discworld dies properly and the unclaimed life force has to go somewhere. In one strand a man who has never had a life finds out he now has a finite one, in the other Ankh-Morpork fills up with surplus vitality. The book follows the consequences with real care, not just the joke.

andel.blurb: On her first assignment a guardian angel falls in love with the earthly boy she is supposed to watch over, while he occasionally glimpses her and her superiors keep watch on them both.

atlantida.blurb: Missing planes and ships in the Bermuda Triangle, the Devil's Sea and a region of Cambodia turn out to be the work of an ancient hostile force, and a former Green Beret who once survived it is called back to face it.

azincourt.blurb: Nicholas Hook, an English archer under sentence of death, escapes the noose by joining an expedition to France and marches with Henry V through the siege of Harfleur to the battle of Agincourt in 1415.

benrok.blurb: After the tyrant Hestis is defeated and a new queen takes the throne, his son Benrok flees her soldiers, tries to find a place in the changed kingdom, and is courted by his father's old allies who want the new rule undone.

bila-perla.blurb: In 1941 British Malaya, Constance Hadley, the bored wife of a rubber planter, flees the Japanese advance on the family yacht with her husband, her son, friends, stowaways and an enigmatic boat dealer who is the only man who can navigate the islands.

bozi-pest.blurb: During the 1990-91 Gulf War, SAS officer Mike Martin goes undercover in occupied Kuwait and then Baghdad to find a suspected Iraqi superweapon before the Allied ground offensive begins.

bud-jako-reka.blurb: In 1948 Colorado, Victoria Nash meets a drifter while delivering peaches from her family's orchard; the meeting changes both their lives. After a tragedy she survives alone in the mountains as the Gunnison River is dammed and her family's land is submerged.

carovenik.blurb: Stepan goes into the woods on Walpurgis Night to find a witch's-broom growth he wants to graft, and runs into three mysterious figures who turn the outing into a nightmare. The same day he meets Jindriska, the only person who can help him.

cerny-dort.blurb: Estranged siblings Byron and Benny reunite after their mother's death to find they have been left a traditional Caribbean black cake and a long voice recording, in which she tells the story of a young swimmer who fled her island home under suspicion of murder.

cesta-ctnosti.blurb: Antonia Caenis, an imperial household slave and later freedwoman, and Vespasian, a country-born officer with a career to build, meet in the palace under Tiberius and keep returning to each other across the reigns of Caligula, Claudius and Nero as he climbs towards the throne.

cesta-pousti.blurb: A partly autobiographical novel following Stepan, a Czech Jewish adolescent, through first loves, work on the land, his relations with his parents and the competing ideologies of the twentieth century, with the Second World War largely as context.

cestovatelska-krev.blurb: Eveline, a young competitive runner raised by her mother, escapes a dangerous situation during a forest training run by crossing into a parallel world, where she joins the Order of Travellers, learns to use her ability and faces what hunts travellers.

chasidske-povidky-z-doby-holocaustu.blurb: Eighty-nine short tales of the Holocaust, recorded from survivors' oral testimony and set down in the form of the traditional Hasidic story. Most centre on East European Hasidim and turn on an intervention, a rescue or an act of loyalty.

chrlic.blurb: A stone gargoyle on St Vitus Cathedral comes to life in heavy rain and sets out into Prague to find out what its purpose is, meeting kind and hostile spirits and befriending a young girl.

cina.blurb: Beginning in 1839 on the eve of the First Opium War, the novel follows Chinese, British and American families through the Taiping Rebellion, the Boxer Uprising and the fall of the empire.

dedictvi-nibelungu.blurb: A century after Siegfried killed Fafnir, his descendants live in Iceland, where prince Sigfinn plans a future with Brynja until the Nibelungs persuade the gods to alter time and the pair wake in a dark age ruled by the immortal Hurgan.

denik-dory-grayove.blurb: Hanka is uprooted from the city to the countryside and hates it until she finds an old notebook in the attic, the diary of Dora Grayova. She sets out to discover what became of its author and of her Jewish friend during the war.
denik-dory-grayove.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

diplomatova-zena.blurb: Marta Nederman, a Polish resistance member, survives a Nazi camp and meets Paul, an American soldier, at the liberation. After his death she marries a British diplomat, and two years later British intelligence sends her back to Poland to identify a traitor.

dum-na-utesu.blurb: After her mother's death Rebecca finds a letter from an elderly Cornish cousin, Olivia, begging for help to save her house. She goes down to restore the crumbling clifftop property and uncovers what happened there during the Second World War.

holky-z-detroitu.blurb: Cleaning a 1920s car she inherited, Melanie finds her distant aunt Violet's journal in a hidden compartment; Violet's account of leaving Kentucky for Detroit runs alongside Melanie's own choice between a promotion and love.

hrichy-rodu-borgiu.blurb: Esther, a Jewish girl baptised and renamed Violante, enters the household of Lucrezia Borgia as a lady-in-waiting and follows her to Ferrara for her marriage to Alfonso d'Este, while becoming entangled with Lucrezia's brother Cesare.

hubert-hugo.blurb: Ten short comics episodes following Hubert and Hugo, a fearless father-and-son pair of mountaineers, through encounters with the elements, ancient creatures and their own family past.

hubitel.blurb: A collection of short pieces and routines by William S. Burroughs, published in 1973, ranging over an exterminator's trade, political satire and hallucinatory fragments.

ilustrado.blurb: The body of Crispin Salvador, a controversial figure of Philippine letters, is pulled from the Hudson River and the manuscript of his last book is missing. His student Miguel returns to Manila and reconstructs his life from his writings, interviews and memoirs.

in-the-lives-of-puppets.blurb: Victor Lawson, the only human in a forest treehouse he shares with the android who raised him and two eccentric machines, repairs a salvaged android called Hap and uncovers a shared past that brings the Authority down on the family and takes them across a hostile country to rescue his father.
in-the-lives-of-puppets.pitch: A boy raised by machines in a forest treehouse repairs a salvaged android called Hap, and the family is pulled across a hostile country. The book is about what Victor and Hap want from each other and what they will accept, and its title asks who the puppet really is.

invaze.blurb: Britain, AD 44: Optio Horatius Figulus, picked for the mission because his half-Celtic parentage gives him the local language, escorts a deposed king of the Durotriges to Lindinis to overthrow a usurper, against an imperial envoy's interference and a druidic sect stirring revolt.

jak-se-vari-drak.blurb: Adam lives on a colony ship and learns at school to modify living creatures by genetic engineering; bored with giving rats gills, he sets out to build an intelligent fire-breathing dragon of his own.

kamzikuv-velky-skok.blurb: A young chamois loses his older brother, and with his mother's help learns to live with the death and jump the gap of fear and confusion.

kdo-odejde-uz-se-nevraci.blurb: Raised in the insular Skverer Hasidic sect and married at eighteen, the author's curiosity leads him from a forbidden radio to a public library and the internet, until his faith gives way. He is expelled from his village for heresy and loses contact with his five children.
kdo-odejde-uz-se-nevraci.pitch: Shulem Deen grows up in the insular Skverer Hasidic sect, marries at eighteen, and begins to test what he was raised to believe, from a forbidden radio to a library and the internet. A closed religious world opens up from inside, told by a man honestly asking whether the thing he was forbidden to question is true. It begins with a thirteen-year-old taken to a village he did not want to visit.

kdo-zastavi-dest.blurb: Sixteen-year-old Ema emigrates to her grandparents in Britain after 1968 and spends a summer on Cyprus among the wealthy British set, where she meets a British soldier, James. Their correspondence continues as the island slides toward the Turkish invasion.

klan-gucci.blurb: A journalist's account of the Gucci family and its company, from the founder through the Investcorp buyout and the Tom Ford turnaround, framed by the 1995 shooting of Maurizio Gucci in Milan and the conviction of his ex-wife Patrizia Reggiani for arranging it.

kniha-o-tichu.blurb: Josef Formanek retells stories from his own travels and from people he met - beyond the Arctic Circle, in the Serengeti, in the rainforest - built around moments of silence in which someone has to decide how to go on.

kniha-ztracenych-jmen.blurb: A retired librarian in Florida recognises a photograph of a book she last saw in 1944, a forger's ledger in which she and a fellow forger encoded the real names of Jewish children given false papers to reach Switzerland.

kolos.blurb: Babylon, 323 BC: Alexander the Great survives, and turns the war elephants he brought back from India towards Carthage. A young elephant handler, the only man who can calm the beast Colossus, rises through the Macedonian ranks and has to choose between his ambition and what he loves.

kralovna-parize.blurb: Paris under German occupation: Coco Chanel lives at the Ritz among the Reich's High Command while trying to wrest full control of her perfume company from her Jewish business partner, and agrees to travel to Spain as a spy in exchange for protection.

kralovnin-klenotnik.blurb: From 1593: George Heriot, goldsmith and lender to Anna of Denmark, follows the Scottish court south when James VI inherits the English throne, financing the crown and navigating palace intrigue and English contempt for the Scots.

krev-budoucnosti.blurb: In a near-future New York divided by a wall, a parent who has lost the means to treat a terminally ill daughter accepts a criminal offer to have the child continue in a virtual world, which puts her against the surveillance state.

kronika-zlatych-casu.blurb: Nine previously unpublished science-fiction stories by a Czech writer, about murderous angels, intelligent cats, vampires in Zizkov, successful entrepreneurs and other creatures living among us.

legenda-o-brokenu.blurb: Presented as a rediscovered ancient manuscript, the novel alternates between the walled city of Broken, whose army commander and merchant lord manoeuvre as plague and war approach, and the exiled forest-dwelling Bane, whose tracker allies with a mutilated philosopher to bring the city down.

louceni-s-jeruzalemem.blurb: A late novel by a Czech-Israeli writer in which a concentration-camp past, present-day Jewish-Palestinian politics, a death and a prophecy converge on the discovery of love, erotic and spiritual, between two people well into middle age in Jerusalem.

lovkyne.blurb: A British war correspondent turned Nazi hunter, a Soviet night bomber pilot who survived his target, and a teenage photographer in post-war Boston converge on a German woman who murdered civilians and then vanished.

matrjoska.blurb: An undefined catastrophe empties the world of people and animals; Karel, who was in a fallout shelter, wakes to a changed Prague and the handful of others who also survived underground must decide what to do next.

mesicni-stin.blurb: A hippie is abducted from Earth by inscrutable beings of light and gives birth to Moonshadow, who escapes a deep-space zoo and grows up crossing a universe at war; the story is narrated by Moonshadow in old age.

mesto-rozkvetu.blurb: New York from 1864: Joshua Turner, home from the Civil War with a peg leg, sets out to build the city's first steel-framed apartment buildings uptown, opposed by an enemy from his past, while the Turner and Devrey family fortunes shift around him.

mesto-v-oblacich.blurb: Five lives across six centuries - a girl in besieged Constantinople, a boy on an Ottoman farm, a Korean War veteran translating Greek in an Idaho library, a teenager who brings a bomb into that library, and a girl aboard a ship bound for an exoplanet - are linked by a fragmentary ancient tale about a man trying to reach a city in the clouds.

milenci-v-roce-2042.blurb: In a near-future Europe reshaped by a directive on religious correctness, a young Czech doctor studying in Germany meets Yamina, a devout Muslim student, and their relationship becomes the centre of the book.

moriandr.blurb: Twins Michal and Marie are brought a cat wearing a medallion marked M by a strong wind, and are taken on a journey through the fantasy landscapes of the kingdom of Moriandr.

mosty-pres-propast-casu.blurb: Two loosely linked novels in one volume, in which descendants of an advanced human civilisation return from space to Earth and find themselves among the wars, slave raids and religious hatred of the sixteenth century.

na-prvni-pohled.blurb: Rachel, a courtroom reporter, breaks off her engagement and by chance meets Ben, her inseparable university friend of ten years earlier, now a lawyer and married. Present-day chapters alternate with flashbacks to their student years.

navrat-z-nicoty.blurb: Martin Pistorius fell ill at twelve, lost speech and movement, and was diagnosed as vegetative. He regained awareness years before anyone realised it, and spent over a decade unable to signal that he was present, until a carer noticed and helped him learn to communicate by computer.
navrat-z-nicoty.pitch: Martin Pistorius lost speech and movement at twelve and was treated as if nothing was left, while his mind was awake and heard everything people say in front of someone they think is not there. The book gives real insight into how a person nobody can interview experiences the world, and follows him toward finally being noticed and learning to communicate.

neco-uzasneho.blurb: Margot, an addicted prostitute on the run from her pimp, is helped by a strange boy called Kristian who performs what looks like a miracle the next day; her attempt to find out who he is draws her into a dark world and the attention of a powerful society.

nevinnost.blurb: Addison Goodheart, whose face drives anyone who sees it to murderous rage, lives hidden beneath a city until he meets Gwyneth, a young woman who cannot bear to be touched and is being hunted by the man who killed her father.
nevinnost.pitch: Addison Goodheart's face drives anyone who sees it to murderous rage, so he lives beneath the city, and he is both interesting and easy to cheer for. He tells it in his own voice. The book turns expectation around: the one who looks like a monster is the innocent, and the central relationship is deliberately untouchable.

nocni-ptacata.blurb: In the city of Simta, the Nightbirds are girls who can gift magic with a kiss, hidden and guarded by the great houses and hunted by the church. Matilde, Aesa and Sayer spend their season bestowing gifts on paying clients until they learn their powers are stronger than they were told.

novy-hrabe-monte-christo.blurb: A Hungarian nobleman's conspiracy is betrayed and he is condemned; he escapes, and fifteen years later returns under another name as a wealthy doctor to bring the men who informed on him to justice.

novy-vek.blurb: On the factual record of the seventeenth-century Jewish Sabbatian heresy and the false prophet Sabbatai Zevi, Bondy builds a parable about hope, belief and whether a society can be changed.

od-seminka-v-prach.blurb: Marc Hamer records his last year as the sole gardener on a twelve-acre Welsh estate, season by season, alongside the plants and animals he works among and the reticent widowed owner he has worked for over two decades.

ostrov-ztracenych-snu.blurb: Lorelei learns she has inherited property in Tasmania and travels there to find out who left it to her and what really happened to her father, running into her hostile stepmother and an unexpected love.

panna-ve-zbroji.blurb: Joan of Arc's childhood friend and secretary, writing sixty years after her death, recounts her life from the village of Domremy through the campaign that crowned a king to her trial and burning at Rouen.
panna-ve-zbroji.pitch: Joan of Arc's childhood friend and secretary recounts her life sixty years after her death, from the village of Domremy through the campaign that crowned a king to the trial at Rouen. At the centre is a peasant girl who wants one thing with total clarity. The trial section, built from the actual transcripts, is the part readers single out.

po-stopach-ztraceneho-syna.blurb: Vojta, Jindra and Tereza have already uncovered the secrets of a treasure cave and an old brickworks, but their friendship has soured. Jindra runs away from home to a half-ruined gamekeeper's lodge, where a loose stone in the wall hides letters a hundred years old.
po-stopach-ztraceneho-syna.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

pohadka-z-hnizda.blurb: A young blackbird tells the story of its first spring in the garden of a big house, in a series of short adventures seen from a bird's point of view.
pohadka-z-hnizda.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

popletene-pocitani.blurb: An interactive counting book in which a prince enlists a wizard to free a princess from a dragon, the wizard's spells go wrong and turn one dragon head into six, and the child is asked to count along.
popletene-pocitani.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

poprve.blurb: After sixteen years of marriage, Chicago lawyer Jake leaves his wife Mattie for his latest mistress; days later Mattie is diagnosed with ALS, and he moves back in to care for her while their teenage daughter watches the family come apart.

prapor.blurb: Summer 1862: Nathaniel Starbuck, a Bostonian serving as a Confederate officer under Stonewall Jackson, distinguishes himself at Cedar Mountain, falls foul of his own brigade commander, and is carried into the Second Battle of Manassas.

prezil-jsem-varsavske-ghetto.blurb: A grain merchant's son, born 1935, is confined with his family to the ghetto of Zychlin in 1940 and escapes with his father to the Warsaw ghetto in 1942, where his mother does not survive the journey. He is hidden alone with paid helpers and lives through the ghetto's destruction.

pribeh-biafry.blurb: Frederick Forsyth's first book, a 1969 eyewitness account of the Nigerian Civil War from the Biafran side, arguing that the secession was crushed with British arms and advice.

pulnocni-ruze.blurb: Anahita Chavan, born into an impoverished noble Indian family in 1911, becomes companion to a princess and travels to England; ninety years later her great-grandson follows her written account to an English estate where an actress is filming.

rad.blurb: Malta, 1565. Mattias Tannhauser, a German arms merchant and former Janissary, is hired by Contessa Carla to find the illegitimate son she was made to give up, and is caught on the island as Suleiman's armada begins the Great Siege.

rebel.blurb: Nathaniel Starbuck, the disgraced son of a Boston abolitionist preacher, is stranded in Richmond as the Civil War begins and joins the Confederate regiment of the man who saved his life, ending up in the field against his own people.

revi-a-mesto-snu.blurb: Revi, a fifteen-year-old with an incurable illness, is the only inhabitant of the AI-run City of Dreams who can still dream, and when a girl in his dreams asks for help for the world beyond the Wall, Omnicloud announces the Wall is failing.
revi-a-mesto-snu.pitch: Revi, fifteen and incurably ill, is the only inhabitant of the AI-run City of Dreams who can still dream. The idea is a city that has traded away dreaming for safety and abundance, and a boy whose illness is the only reason he still can. The opening unfolds Omnicloud, the drones and the Council of the Wise gradually and explains the futuristic elements clearly, and Revi has his sister and an old ally beside him.

robotics.blurb: Matias Karingen is a young student of robot science in a world where people and machines live side by side; he trains for robotic duels and sets out to uncover what lies behind his technological society.

sesterstvo-a-sila-moci.blurb: The magic cat Fabiola leads Bara, Misa and Ela to Zahradky, a former allotment colony that has become a refuge for animals. When the new mayor decides to raze it, the three girls try to change his plans.
sesterstvo-a-sila-moci.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

sestry-z-titaniku.blurb: Two Irish sisters sail on the Titanic to take up posts in America, and after the sinking one of them takes the other's name and place as a governess.

severka.blurb: Ri Jo-jong, daughter of a high-placed North Korean propagandist, recounts her childhood in Pyongyang and her later life in South Korea, and asks the reader to sit in judgement on the choices she made.
severka.pitch: Ri Jo-jong, daughter of a high-placed Pyongyang propagandist, becomes an emigrant not quite by her own choice and hands you her account, asking you to judge her life. The idea at its heart is what a person can sell of herself to buy her own freedom, and both of her worlds seem equally false to her.

sibirsky-kseft.blurb: In the early 1990s an American fund manager and his Czech partner travel into the far north of Russia to buy up privatisation vouchers entitling holders to shares in a state oil company, and draw the attention of the Russian mafia and the emerging oligarchs.

silena-touha-tancit.blurb: Doriel Waldman, a Jewish expatriate in New York whose parents survived the war only to die soon afterwards, believes he is possessed by a dybbuk and submits to psychoanalysis; his narration alternates with his analyst's case notes.

sklarka-z-benatek.blurb: Orsola Rosso grows up in a Murano glassmaking family in 1486 and, after her father dies, learns to make glass beads to support the workshop. The novel follows her and her family across five centuries of Venetian history while they age only a few decades.

sovi-pribeh.blurb: Jaja Melounova, an apparently ordinary girl from Prague's Kampa, is drawn into a fight for the balance of power in a magical Prague, where an army of grey phantoms grows stronger with each Sunday of Advent and threatens to end Christmas.

starostliva-veverka.blurb: Ondra and Nela find an injured squirrel by the road and get it to a wildlife rescue station. The next day they find two chilled squirrel kits at the same spot and have to work out whether they belong to the animal they saved.
starostliva-veverka.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

statecny-cap.blurb: Lenka goes to a two-week summer camp in south Bohemia without her best friend and dreads it, until the other children win her over. On a trip into town she finds an injured stork in the chimney of a derelict factory.
statecny-cap.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

strach-ma-velke-oci.blurb: Nine short, mildly spooky stories told by Masha from the animated series, each about a everyday childhood fear such as a new sibling, animals or a new school, and each ending with her advice on coping with it.
strach-ma-velke-oci.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

strasidelne-pribehy.blurb: A collection of short Disney-based bedtime stories, including Mowgli saving a baby elephant from Shere Khan, Winnie the Pooh and his friends swapping spooky tales, and Peter Pan outwitting Captain Hook.

stripky-vzpominek.blurb: Serena, daughter of an Italian noble family executed under Mussolini, is sent to America, marries an American officer against his family's wishes, and after his death makes a life as a model while raising her daughters.

svedectvi-o-zivote-v-kldr.blurb: A Czech Koreanist presents seven interviews with North Korean defectors - among them a student, a driver, a trader, a professor and a pensioner - on everyday life, work, schooling and adolescence inside the country.
svedectvi-o-zivote-v-kldr.pitch: Seven interviews with North Korean defectors, chosen by a Czech Koreanist who has been inside the country twice. The subjects are ordinary lives, a student, a driver, a trader, a professor, a pensioner, on whether there are nightclubs and what adolescence is like, which is where the real understanding comes from.

svetlo-po-valce.blurb: Two Hungarian friends who jumped from a train to Auschwitz arrive in Naples in 1946 and try to build new lives, a search that takes them on to Ellis Island and Caracas.

tajemstvi-hvezd.blurb: In the summer of 1914 a Jewish physicist in Russia must photograph a solar eclipse to prove his equations and win his family passage to America; when he and his sister's fiance disappear, she sets out across a country sliding into war to find them.

utek-ze-sveta.blurb: A young woman vanishes from a supermarket car park, leaving a husband and small daughter; eleven years later she reappears at a Montana filling station with a baby, and her return upends the family that moved on.

v-jine-dobe.blurb: In 1931 Germany a bookshop owner and a Jewish violinist fall in love; he narrates the pre-war years, she wakes in a field in 1946 with ten years of her life missing.

vabeni-mesice.blurb: Seventeen-year-old Sara has an ability her father kept from her. After a car crash kills her parents, she learns that the man who caused it is a werewolf who intends to poison her and recruit her, and she meets the protector assigned to her.

valentynka-a-narozeniny.blurb: Nine-year-old Valentynka, part dreamer and part explorer, lives in an old house with her parents, grandmother, aunt, uncle and dog, and gets into funny and dramatic scrapes with her three best friends - chiefly while making fizzy bath bombs as presents.
valentynka-a-narozeniny.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

valka-o-preziti-lidske-rasy.blurb: A two-day fourth world war in 2142 leaves the world near destruction, and an insignificant Confederation soldier named Simons turns out to hold humanity's survival in his hands.

valka-skoncila-na-hane.blurb: A Czech officer's diary-based account of his own path through the Second World War, from the pre-war years to its end in Moravia.

vceli-bodnuti.blurb: The Barnes family in small-town Ireland come apart after the crash: the father's car dealership is failing and he starts building a bunker in the woods, the mother sells the family's possessions online, and the two children are left to their own troubles. Four long sections tell the same months from each of them.

ve-stinu-sfingy.blurb: Jake Ransom tries to return to Calypsos with his father's watch but lands instead in an Egyptian-flavoured desert region of Pangaea, where he and his friends are captured by Princess Nefertiti and then join her against the Skull King.

velka-laska-malych-rozmeru.blurb: Seville, 1490. Diego Vasquez, the city's most celebrated painter, is a dwarf and a converso living in daily fear of the Inquisition. He is set to teach art to Mencia Goncalvez, a nobleman's daughter promised to wealth and power, and their love brings a rival knight's denunciation down on him.

vitek-krupadlo-a-kostizrout.blurb: Thirteen-year-old Vitek spends the holidays at his grandmother's in Male Zernoseky and sets out to find what happened to his great-great-great-grandfather, in a branching adventure the reader steers through riddles and ciphers.

vrazedna-pole.blurb: A Cambodian doctor recounts his family's life before the Khmer Rouge, then the years he survived forced labour, starvation and three imprisonments by concealing that he was educated. Written with a journalist co-author who met him in a refugee camp in 1980.
vrazedna-pole.pitch: A Cambodian doctor survives the Khmer Rouge by pretending to be a taxi driver, because the regime treats education itself as a crime. A first-person, chronological account, written with a journalist he met in a refugee camp, and it shows how that logic worked differently in each zone of the country.

vyhled-pres-strechy.blurb: In 1941 occupied Amsterdam, mathematics professor Josef Held impulsively offers a hiding place in his attic to Michael Blum, a Jewish former student fleeing the Gestapo.

zazemi.blurb: A short prose work of remembered fragments about the loss of a grandmother, a house and a city, moving between the narrator's childhood and her adult life as a mother.

zidle-pro-anhelinu.blurb: Twelve-year-old Anhelina has fled the war in Ukraine with her mother and is placed in an ordinary Czech classroom, where she refuses to learn the language while she has no news of the rest of her family, and where she keeps meeting a silent boy in a hood who does not attend school.
zidle-pro-anhelinu.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

zlodeji-rek.blurb: Newfoundland, 1810s. The Peytons, father and son, and their housekeeper Cassie live by fishing and trapping in country still held by the Beothuk. A naval officer is sent to investigate the killings that accompanied the capture of a Beothuk woman brought back to the coast.

znameni-ktere-neprislo.blurb: Teodor, a veteran UN diplomat, sees his activist daughter Joanna die in a politically motivated killing in the Middle East and sets out to establish who was responsible, first suspecting the head of a human rights organisation, then weighing revenge and self-punishment, and finally finding the guilt lay elsewhere than he assumed.
znameni-ktere-neprislo.pitch: Teodor, a veteran UN diplomat, believes that words are what work; his activist daughter believed only deeds do. When she is killed in the Middle East, he sets out to learn who is responsible. It is closer to intellectual contemplation with a political charge than to a crime thriller, centred on one narrator and his own guilt.

mezi-truny-lvu.blurb: 1471: Nicholas de Fleury, having taken his young son from his estranged wife Gelis, stages an expensive Nativity play for the Scottish king and then sails for Iceland on the largest commercial scheme of his career, while rival companies, polar ice and an enemy who knows his secrets close in.

uder-tornada.blurb: Six teenage friends travel to Oklahoma to see Native American culture for themselves, and when a tornado strikes their trip turns into a fight for survival across tornado alley.
uder-tornada.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

vitezstvi-orla.blurb: Britain, AD 43. Centurion Macro and his optio Cato fight through the legions' advance on Camulodunum while someone inside the Roman camp is supplying weapons to the Britons and a conspiracy forms against the visiting Emperor Claudius.

amira-z-haremu.blurb: Amira Badir, raised in the women's quarters of a wealthy family in a fictional Gulf state and married into the ruling house, is beaten and nearly killed by her husband; a doctor smuggles her and her son out with a new identity, and she rebuilds a life in America as a psychologist.

andele-dne-a-noci.blurb: Three characters in different countries reach a turning point at the same time: a Czech businesswoman facing the collapse of her company and her marriage, a Basque journalist breaking with his terrorist past, and a Moscow teacher working for a nationalist organisation after his wife's death.

arabie.blurb: In 1900 the magic atlas sends Bara to live among the bedouin of Arabia, where she meets Alois Musil, a Catholic priest who is also a sheikh, and must cross the desert with him to Damascus.

babka-z-domku-na-kuri-nozce.blurb: An old woman who has resolved never to leave her cottage again is taken travelling anyway, because the cottage stands on a hen's leg and sets off on its own.
babka-z-domku-na-kuri-nozce.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-09-01)

bylinkova-babicka.blurb: A grandmother with seven grandchildren keeps a secret: she can find hidden and magical things in nature that other people cannot see. Over one fairy-tale summer holiday the children discover this, and each learns what a particular herb is good for.

cesta.blurb: A drive from France to Prague becomes the occasion for a sarcastic stream of recollection and reflection on unpunished guilt and the friction between cultures developing at different speeds.

cesty-na-sibir.blurb: A young Czech biologist abandons an academic career and family life for repeated journeys across Siberia and the Russian Far East, gathering the life stories of the people he meets.

elektricky-michelangelo.blurb: Cy Parks grows up on Morecambe Bay, apprentices to an alcoholic tattoo artist, then sets up on the Coney Island boardwalk as the Electric Michelangelo, where a circus performer commissions him to cover her body in tattooed eyes.

fantasticka-dobrodruzstvi-alfreda-kroppa.blurb: Fifteen-year-old Alfred Kropp is talked into helping his uncle steal a sword from his employer, and discovers he has handed Excalibur to a man who means to use it; he then joins the last knight of an ancient order in trying to get it back.

holka-od-koni.blurb: Wills, a seventh grader whose mother is deployed overseas, trains at a riding academy in Nebraska, hoping to join the popular riders and to keep her school horse from being retired.

index-hruzy.blurb: Alex Hoffmann, a physicist running a Geneva hedge fund, has built an algorithm that trades on signs of global anxiety. After an intruder breaks into his house, a single day sees the machine begin acting outside human control while Hoffmann's grip on reality slips.
index-hruzy.pitch: A physicist runs a Geneva hedge fund on an algorithm that trades on signs of global anxiety, and one night an intruder breaks into his house. The idea is a system built to measure fear that starts manufacturing it, because that is exactly what it was told to optimise. The best scene is a consequence check: he cuts the power in the server room and the machine keeps trading.

jak-postavit-lod.blurb: Thirteen-year-old Jamie O'Neill, autistic and obsessed with patterns, arrives at a new school in the west of Ireland determined to build a perpetual motion machine; an English teacher and a woodwork teacher take up his project and redirect it into building a traditional boat.
jak-postavit-lod.pitch: Jamie is thirteen, autistic and obsessed with patterns, and wants to build a perpetual motion machine because he believes ceaseless movement is how he reaches the mother he never knew. The book is page time on what one boy wants and why, and what a thing built by many hands can answer that a private machine cannot. A Booker-longlisted novel set in the west of Ireland.

je-to-jenom-sranda.blurb: Three students at an American high school compete in a beauty and talent contest decided by online voting, each fighting a private battle - anorexia, steroids, vitiligo - behind the campaign.

He is an analyst, not a warrior, with nothing but the thing he is truly good at, and he knows restoring order will be work rather than a battle won. Space opera built on one man's wits and motives.

den-nula.blurb: Pounce, a robot nanny built in the shape of a plush tiger, discovers he is disposable just as an uprising turns machines against people. He has to get his eight-year-old charge across a country where every other bot wants the boy dead.
den-nula.pitch: Pounce is a robot nanny shaped like a plush tiger who learns he is disposable, and must choose between the directive he was built for and saving himself. Then he has to get his eight-year-old charge across a country where every other bot wants the boy dead. The book asks whether a machine built to love can be said to own that love.

desy-prvni-republiky.blurb: In four stories framed by the years 1934 to 1937, four elderly men recount the strange things that once intruded on their safe world, from a Prague asylum graveyard and the Kenyan jungle to a village near Novy Jicin.

dlouha-cesta-na-malou-rozzlobenou-planet.blurb: A young clerk takes a job aboard a small ship that builds hyperspace tunnels, and the mixed-species crew accepts a long, lucrative contract to punch a tunnel through to a newly admitted and hostile world.
dlouha-cesta-na-malou-rozzlobenou-planet.pitch: A young clerk takes a job on a small ship that builds hyperspace tunnels, and the crew, each of a different species with its own biology and customs, accepts a long contract to a hostile world. Nearly all of it is about the people, with warmth, three gentle romances, and conflicts that end through understanding.

dlouhy-cerny-usvit.blurb: The Agency's most capable agents are being killed off, setting off conspiracies, murders and double-crosses. Parallel worlds begin to bleed into one another while a full-scale war is fought in tunnels under Switzerland.

do-poklidne-modri.blurb: Aria and Perry race Sable and Hess to reach the Still Blue, the last shelter from the ether storms destroying the world.

druha-sance.blurb: A man and his young daughter cross a depopulated world looking for answers about a past neither of them remembers, hoping the sun will one day set again. The story moves between our own past and a distant future.

duna.blurb: Duke Leto Atreides, ruling Caladan, is drawn into imperial politics and a Harkonnen feud in the years immediately before his house is moved to the desert planet Arrakis.

epizody-2084.blurb: A collection of twenty Czech science-fiction stories, all set in the year 2084, imagining how politics, technology and society might look a century after Orwell's date.

fandom.blurb: Violet, her brother and two friends are transported at a comic convention into The Gallows Dance, the dystopian franchise they cosplay, where the genetically enhanced hang the underclass and the rebellion's heroine has just died by their arrival.

flotila-zatracenych.blurb: Adequin Rake and her people have escaped the collapsing edge of the universe with a handful of other survivors, but their ancient ship has no working engines and starvation is close. Cavalon Mercer, exiled heir and engineer, and a team sent after an exotic material are the way back to civilised space.
flotila-zatracenych.pitch: Adequin Rake and her people have escaped the collapsing edge of the universe with a handful of other survivors, but their ancient ship has no working engines and starvation is close. She sends a team after the exotic material that would let them move, and exiled engineer Cavalon Mercer has to prove he is better than he believes. A practical problem with an engineering answer, solved with a companion beside you.

hlidka-na-konci-vesmiru.blurb: The Divide is the edge of the universe, and the Sentinels posted along it are exiles, convicts and soldiers nobody wanted. Adequin Rake, commanding the ancient ship Argus with no supplies and no communications, gets a new recruit in the disgraced nobleman Cavalon Mercer just as the boundary itself begins to collapse.
hlidka-na-konci-vesmiru.pitch: At the edge of the universe, Adequin Rake commands an ancient ship with no supplies and no communications, and keeps deciding to try anyway. Her new recruit is a disowned aristocrat who is now the only engineer aboard, and the bond between them stays platonic and carries the emotional weight. A misfit crew, a collapsing boundary, and people choosing to spend themselves for others.

hranice-imperia.blurb: Daniel Hankerson, a genetically enhanced member of the imperial family, works for fleet intelligence and reads people for a living. An attempted robbery that turns into an assassination attempt convinces him that the survey mission he is being sent on, to the far edge of the Central Empire, is a cover for something else.
hranice-imperia.pitch: Daniel Hankerson reads people for a living, at the intelligence desk and the card table, and that is how he works out that the routine survey mission to the empire's far edge is not routine. The empire is held together by compromises, with internal enemies worse than the external ones, and readers report characters with real depth.

hvezdni-honaci.blurb: Interstellar travel depends on giant hyperspace creatures nicknamed cows, which carry people, machines and raw materials in their bodies and are escorted by human herders. A ruthless monopolist arrives with cruisers, cyborg armies and killer lizards, destroying planets, cows and even stars.

hvezdy-ceske-sci-fi.blurb: Five leading Czech science-fiction writers each contribute a previously unpublished short novel or novella set in the series they are best known for. The pieces are otherwise unconnected.

idealni-svet.blurb: In Munich in 2052 Samson Freitag works for the Agency for Life Counselling, which observes citizens around the clock so the state can place each of them where they serve society best. Accused of having given one citizen the wrong advice, he becomes a subject of the optimisation he administered.
idealni-svet.pitch: Munich, 2052: a state that watches everyone to assign each citizen the role in which he is most useful, and a civil servant who administers it until one recommendation turns the machine on him. Reviewers credit a thought-through world, and the sharpest idea is that disputed facts are no longer verified but wikified.

invaze-zlodeju-tel.blurb: In Mill Valley, California, Dr Miles Bennell finds his patients convinced that their relatives have been replaced by exact but emotionless duplicates, and traces the cause to giant seed pods that copy and absorb a living body while it sleeps.
invaze-zlodeju-tel.pitch: A small-town doctor hears patient after patient insist that a relative is not the person they claim to be. The town calls it contagious delusion, and the book works out what is really replacing people and what is lost when a copy has every memory and scar but nothing it feels. Short, one narrator, one town, and the idea lingers.

kepler62-parvela.blurb: The child crew bound for the planet Kepler62e finally learn what their capsule concealed: a stowaway bent on power who intends to wipe out anyone inconvenient and rule as a dictator, and Marie, Ari and his little brother must defend themselves and their new home.

kepler62-sorland.blurb: In an overcrowded, resource-starved future, thirteen-year-old Ari looks after his younger brother Joni while hiding that their mother has vanished. When Joni is handed a copy of Kepler62, a computer game said to be impossible to finish, the brothers complete it and discover it is an invitation.

kepler62-sortland.blurb: The expedition is settling in on Kepler62e; Ari stays at the base with his little brother Joni while Marie explores alone, and neither trusts the others after the tragedy that struck the grass people or the expedition leader's calm about a new virus among the children.

komanda-omega.blurb: The Omega commandos are saboteurs, spies and assassins answerable only to the emperor, their bodies improved by illegal genetic modification that also shortens their lives. Hila Ebanová, taken from the slums of Colbran as a child, serves in one such unit when it is betrayed and the empire decides to erase its existence.
komanda-omega.pitch: These soldiers' genetic enhancement makes them superhuman, is illegal and shortens their lives, and each consequence follows from the last. Hila, taken as a child from the slums of Colbran, serves in an Omega unit when the state that used them decides to erase its existence. Readers report Hila as sympathetic and well written, with political scheming along the way.

koruna-otraveneho-stromu.blurb: A British soldier and Afghanistan veteran, the only survivor of a secret mission, is brought back to Edegom - a world ruled by a mad emperor where any resemblance to the practice of magic means death. He becomes a piece in a struggle over the succession, dependent on a local sorceress, an assassin and a hired protector.

kronovy-deti.blurb: Downtown is collapsing, families are being taken from their homes and mafias are seizing the city while the Council guard keeps Downtowners penned in until the Infection finishes them. With civil war imminent, the city turns to three people as its last hope, among them a special agent.

kronuv-odkaz.blurb: The civil war is over, leaving Attiona City ruined; the uprising won Downtown its freedom along with hunger, lawlessness and a police regime. With Centre and Downtown finally severed, it becomes clear neither can survive without the other, and the city needs the protector it buried.

laila.blurb: Adam Baxa, an elite lawyer at a London firm, discovers a gap in his otherwise perfect memory, and the dazzling Laila who enters his life may be a product of genetic engineering.

laska-az-za-hrob.blurb: Cameron, a journalism student living on the run-down edge of a city, is hunted by an unseen pursuer with satellite surveillance and rifles, after a school assignment led her to a mystery the FBI could not solve.

let-305.blurb: A flight from New York to London loses power and crash-lands in the English countryside, where the survivors find the world around them is not the one they left. A handful of passengers turn out to be connected to why it happened.

lovci-relikvii.blurb: Two centuries after a religious war, a dictatorship of four self-proclaimed gods has banned all other worship; a human smuggler and her masked partner are hired to recover a relic of a faith nobody has heard of.

metro-2035.blurb: Twenty years after a nuclear war, the survivors live in the Moscow metro believing the surface is still lethal. Artyom keeps climbing up to search the airwaves for other survivors, convinced the stations' rulers are hiding that the world above is habitable.

mirzova-vize.blurb: On 21 June 2034 the world falls back into prehistory. One man is stranded at the end of the Mesozoic and another is left in the present, and both try to reverse the catastrophe.

mise-saturn.blurb: In 2066 an observatory employee notices that something entering the solar system is slowing down, which means it is a ship. The United States and China each mount an expedition to reach the alien vessel parked in Saturn's rings first.
mise-saturn.pitch: An observatory employee notices that something entering the solar system is slowing down, which means it is a ship, and two nations race to reach it first. The engineering is done properly: rival mission designs, ion engines, and the hard problem of shedding heat in vacuum. What is out at Saturn, and who gets there, is the question that drives it.

misteri.blurb: The city is the only world its inhabitants know, and outside its walls move twisted creatures; the valkeri are the ones who go out to bring back information and supplies, and most of them do not last long.

muzi-pod-ochranou.blurb: An encephalitis epidemic kills most sexually mature men, and women take political power in the United States. Dr Martinelli, one of the surviving men, is confined to a guarded research institute to develop a vaccine while the new regime tightens around him.

na-vrchol.blurb: An enormous mountain appears in the middle of the Pacific and a scientist of unexplained phenomena joins the expedition sent to reach its summit. The higher the team climbs, the less its members can hold on to time or to their own memories.

nad-ceskymi-zememi-slunce-nezapada.blurb: In 1848 a catastrophe erases parts of the Earth's surface and the oceans rise, destroying some states and creating others - among them the Czecho-Slovak Kingdom. By the 1940s it is a naval power, and it is not the only nation that wants to rule the oceans.

nadherne-posetila-snaha.blurb: Months after April May's disappearance, her friends - a social-media heir, a researcher and a grieving ex - separately pursue what became of her while a tech entrepreneur builds something new from the aliens' technology.

navigatori-duny.blurb: The founding of the Bene Gesserit sisterhood, of the mentat human computers and of the Spacing Guild's navigators, set against a conflict between reason and religious fanaticism.

neco-vic.blurb: A sixteen-year-old drowns himself and wakes, naked and alone, in the abandoned English town where he grew up, and sets out to work out where he is and whether anyone else is left.

nehodni.blurb: A Starfleet fleet returns to the Delta Quadrant to find out what became of the Borg after their absorption into the Caeliar, while Seven of Nine, neither Borg nor human, is tormented by a voice she cannot explain.

neni-krve-bez-ohne.blurb: John Francis Kovář, a former special-forces captain, takes part in the Agency's first mission into another spacetime, expected to be routine. He ends up at the battle of Austerlitz on 2 December 1805, with no means of influencing it.

neocekavany-roboti-exodus.blurb: Long after humanity has gone, the adventurer robot Meriwether and the strictly scientific William return from an exploring expedition to find they have been forgotten, and must avoid being recycled while learning what humans were.

nyxia-nespoutana.blurb: Emmett Atwater and the surviving Genesis crew reach the planet Babel calls Eden and its inhabitants call Magnia, and travel toward its largest city while mining nyxia. The Imago they were sent to deal with have secrets of their own, as does the corporation that hired them.
nyxia-nespoutana.pitch: Emmett Atwater and the surviving Genesis crew reach the planet their employers call Eden and its people call Magnia, and travel toward its largest city while mining nyxia. The Imago they were sent to deal with have secrets of their own, and the corporation's promises begin to look like lies. Emmett wants to get paid, get home, and keep faith with the people beside him.

nyxia-povstava.blurb: Emmett and the Genesis crew ally with the Imago, whose city Babel has destroyed, and learn the planet is weeks from being made uninhabitable by a collision of its two moons. Both groups must reach Babel's orbiting ships and take them.
nyxia-povstava.pitch: Emmett and his crew join forces with the Imago, and now the stakes are other people's survival, not his own payday: getting the last of a doomed people off a planet whose two moons are heading for collision. Self-sacrifice for others is at the heart of it, with Emmett narrating.
