nyxia.blurb: Emmett Atwater, a fifteen-year-old from Detroit, signs a contract with the Babel corporation and boards a ship for the planet Eden to mine nyxia, the most valuable substance in the universe. Ten recruits from poor backgrounds spend the year-long flight competing, and only eight will be allowed to land.
nyxia.pitch: Emmett Atwater, a fifteen-year-old from Detroit, signs a corporate contract because his mother is dying, and boards a ship for the planet Eden to mine nyxia. Ten recruits compete on the year-long flight, and only eight will land. He narrates in an angry, sympathetic voice that reads real, and he is explicitly not the best on his crew at the one special skill. Nyxia itself is shaped by will and can push back on whoever overreaches.

obranci-civilizace.blurb: Daniel Hankerson has survived betrayal and assassination attempts and has repeatedly thwarted the New Protectorate, an enemy that subordinates everything to absolute order. To beat them he needs a large fleet, but most of the imperial navy is committed to a war at the far end of the empire against the Ralgary.
obranci-civilizace.pitch: Daniel Hankerson has survived betrayal and assassination attempts and keeps thwarting the New Protectorate, an enemy that subordinates everything to absolute order. To beat it he needs a large fleet, but most of the navy is far away fighting the Ralgary. Order at any price against continuity at any price is a real argument, and he wins by judging people rather than by out-shooting them.

odchyleni.blurb: The twelve contestants of the Genesis programme, en route through space toward Mars, discover that the show they volunteered for is built on a deception. Leonor, who joined for fame and believed she had her feelings under control, opens up the programme's buried past.

odkaz-protektoru.blurb: Emperor Daniel Hankerson and his allies have ended the war on the far side of the Central Empire, and a fleet is gathering at Davenport for a decisive battle with the New Protectorate. First he has to open a superluminal gate left behind by the vanished Protector civilisation and deal with an enemy inside his own family.
odkaz-protektoru.pitch: Emperor Hankerson has to open a superluminal gate left by the vanished Protector civilisation while a fleet gathers for the decisive battle, and he also has an enemy inside his own family. He is an emperor who wins by judging people, so the book spends its time on what people want and why.

ofelie-scaleova.blurb: In a near-future England where a king has outlawed technology, eighteen-year-old Ophelia Scale joins a resistance movement that wants artificial intelligence brought back. Selected to apply for the royal secret service so she can get close enough to kill the ruler, she falls for his brother instead.

ofenziva-ceskych-zemi.blurb: A continuation of the flooded-world alternate history in which the Czecho-Slovak Kingdom has become a naval power after the catastrophe of the mid-nineteenth century, and now goes on the offensive.

ohrozeni.blurb: The last survivors of the Genesis programme are back from a distant planet and thrown into the whirlwind of fame, launching their own video channels. The past they all wanted to forget resurfaces.

opravari-casu.blurb: Mirek and Maja are thrown together by one irreversible mistake, along with a grandfather who knows the secret of time travel and wants to undo his granddaughter's error but cannot do it himself.

pachatele-zvlastnich-cinu.blurb: In an alternative future where humanity has left space in chaos, keeping order is entrusted to machines rather than to people; five linked stories follow one protagonist through that arrangement.

paul-z-duny.blurb: After Paul Muad'Dib has taken Arrakis, his legions carry his jihad across the galaxy while he accumulates enemies and begins to doubt whether he is building order or chaos.

pisecnici-a-bludny-asteroid.blurb: On the backward desert planet Pisecnice, seven-year-old Lucka and eleven-year-old Tomas go to school, work the alien-dug mines and sleep in an orphanage until an interstellar ship arrives and invites some of them aboard.

podhoubi-smrti.blurb: Aggressive fungi attack the Moravian branch of Agency EF: giant boletes destroy vehicles, fly agarics release narcotic gases and puffballs wreck the equipment used to cross into parallel worlds. John Francis Kovář and his friends have seconds to respond.

pokoleni-starcu.blurb: Decades after nuclear tests in orbit left humanity and its animals sterile, an ageing Algernon Timberlane and his wife Martha flee their isolated village and travel down the Thames with a small group, looking for somewhere better. Interleaved chapters return to the early years of the sterility, when he was recruited to record the species' decline.
pokoleni-starcu.pitch: Decades after orbital nuclear tests left humanity and its animals sterile, an ageing Algernon Timberlane and his wife Martha flee their isolated village and travel down the Thames with a small group, looking for somewhere better. The book spends itself on what such a world actually becomes: villages without young men, domestic animals gone, institutions decaying. The idea stays with you afterwards.

polocas-rozpadu.blurb: A loose continuation set in the same radioactive world after the war, where the old order has vanished and survival is brutal.

posledni-velkomesto.blurb: In the late twenty-third century, two hundred years after the Apocalypse, the inhabitants of the last great city in Europe have split into warring factions after an empress destroyed the social order. A soldier commanding a small army tries to protect civilians while a narrator untangles who is friend and who is enemy.

postak.blurb: Seventeen years after a nuclear and biological war, a wandering storyteller puts on a dead mail carrier's uniform and finds that surviving settlements treat him as the envoy of a government that no longer exists.
postak.pitch: Seventeen years after the war, a wandering storyteller puts on a dead mail carrier's uniform for warmth and finds that the uniform alone makes surviving settlements act as though a government still exists. The idea is plain and the book sticks with it: a nation exists because people believe it does. He is a liar you can still cheer for.

pratele-nadace.blurb: Seventeen writers contribute new stories set in Isaac Asimov's fictional universes, from the positronic robots to the Foundation, as a fiftieth-anniversary tribute. The volume adds prefaces, an afterword and reprints of three Asimov favourites.

problem-tri-teles.blurb: During the Cultural Revolution a Chinese military project secretly attempts contact with extraterrestrial civilisations. Forty years later prominent scientists are dying, a nanotech researcher is drawn into the investigation, and an immersive computer game about a world with three suns holds the explanation.
problem-tri-teles.pitch: During the Cultural Revolution a physics professor is killed in front of his daughter, and her motive from that scene is the strongest character work in the book. Forty years later physics itself appears to have stopped working, prominent scientists are dying, and a nanotech researcher is drawn into the investigation. The question is why, and the explanation reorganises everything that came before.

projekt-kronos.blurb: In 2052, after a nuclear war, Attiona City is one of the last outposts of civilisation, split between a recovering upper city and a Downtown still living the war's aftermath, and eaten from within by a mysterious epidemic. A young Downtowner who wants to be a hero and a recruit trained to hunt the city's most dangerous criminals are drawn into it.

psanci.blurb: Shana's younger sister walks out of the house one morning in a trance and cannot be stopped or woken; other sleepwalkers join her from across America, and a former CDC scientist is recruited to work out what the flock is walking toward.
psanci.pitch: Shana's younger sister walks out of the house in a trance and cannot be woken, and sleepwalkers from across America begin to flock behind her. The book follows what a country does about it: the CDC, a militia movement, a small-town pastor turned figurehead. Its viewpoint chapters are spent on what people want and why.

pulnocni-nebe.blurb: An ageing astronomer refuses evacuation from an Arctic observatory after a catastrophe cuts off all news, and finds a silent child left behind. Millions of miles away an astronaut aboard a returning Jupiter mission tries to work out why every signal from Earth has stopped.

razova-vlna.blurb: In the radioactive ruins after the war, shapeshifting raiders roam and a cult gathers atomic warheads for one final detonation, believing God intended to destroy the world and needs the work finished.

reborn.blurb: Two years after the virus emptied Britain, Leon has survived two winters and hopes the cold has killed it off; news of a rescue ship reaches him, but the virus has not been idle.
reborn.pitch: Two years after the virus emptied Britain, Leon has survived two winters and hopes the cold has killed it off, until news of a rescue ship reaches him. The escalation is the interesting part: the thing that ate the world has absorbed nearly everyone and can now talk to the survivors, which turns a survival chase into a question about what is on the other side of it.

remade.blurb: Leon and his younger sister Grace, newly moved from New York to London, watch a virus from Africa reach the city and dissolve the people around them, and must survive with a wary group of other survivors.

retezova-reakce.blurb: In a ruined, starving world of slavers and post-apocalyptic cults, a tattooed woman with followers who will do anything for her tries to restore the order of the old times as the hardest winter since the war approaches.

spad.blurb: In 2050, a few tens of thousands survive in the ruins of Prague and try to hold on to something like civilisation while the rest of the world fights for survival at anyone's expense.

spojenci-ceskych-zemi.blurb: Two years into the war between the Czecho-Slovak Kingdom and Tsarist Russia, both powers turn their attention to the American continent in search of allies.

sten.blurb: On Vulcan, a centuries-old factory world run by the Company, Karl Sten loses his family in an accident, rebels from the metal warrens beneath the plant, and is eventually recruited into the Eternal Emperor's forces.

stin-mrtveho.blurb: Two novellas: in one, a near-future run by organised crime whose rulers can turn victims into immaterial shadows; in the other, a parallel world where people live for centuries through repeated reincarnations and must destroy each old body.

stranger-things-bond.blurb: In 1969 Indiana, a college student joins a secret government experiment at a local laboratory, discovers she is being dosed with LSD, and meets a small girl with unusual abilities known only by a number.

stranger-things-capetta.blurb: At the start of sophomore year in Hawkins, Robin's friends decide to start pairing off and acting normal, a game she has played for years to avoid being noticed. Realising she likes girls, she sets out to save enough money to escape to Europe for the summer.

stranger-things-davies.blurb: After years of fighting monsters and with his friends scattered, Lucas Sinclair starts high school and finds options beyond his old circle. Joining the basketball team, he begins to work out what being a Black teenager in small-town Indiana means, just as Hawkins goes wrong again.

stranger-things-yovanoff.blurb: Max Mayfield, a skateboarding troublemaker moved from California to Hawkins, Indiana after her mother's remarriage, narrates her family life with her stepbrother Billy and the events of her first months in town.

stretnuti.blurb: The Genesis programme's first televised season is a hit and officially ends in a month, leaving twelve pioneers stranded on Mars ready to lie if lying gets them rescued. Audiences are excited by a new invention meant to help the contestants, without knowing the danger it carries.

studene-svetlo-hvezd.blurb: Nine stories and a novella of hard, grim science fiction: a wreck of a long-missing spaceship, a drop with marines against the creatures that wiped out most of humanity, an artificial moon, and a mass grave a long way from Earth.

svet-v-bouri.blurb: With humanity descending from its pillar-cities back to the ruined surface, a plan to make Earth habitable again requires uncovering the secrets of both the alien creatures and of the people who hid their own.

svetelne-kroky.blurb: Hynek Prokop, an unremarkable cook, quits his job on the day Earth and the surrounding galaxy are reduced to stellar dust. He has to survive and find a place for himself in an intergalactic community, the main rule being not to ask too much and not to go insane.

svetlo-pulsaru.blurb: Ten years after the Colonial Wars end in 2217, the widower Desmond Sommers takes his young daughter to the station Lighthouse in the pulsar system PSR 1257+12 to assume command, and finds his abrupt reassignment suspicious.

synteza.blurb: The starship Titan finds a region of space inhabited entirely by artificial intelligences at war with a destructive force called the Null; when the rescued AI frees Titan's own computer, the crew must decide whether they can still trust their ship.

temny-les.blurb: With an alien fleet four hundred years away and alien surveillance particles making Earth transparent, the UN grants four Wallfacers vast resources to devise strategies they must never explain to anyone. One of them is Luo Ji, an unambitious astronomer who does not know why he was chosen, and whom the enemy wants dead.
temny-les.pitch: An alien fleet is coming and the enemy can see everything on Earth except what stays inside a human head, so the UN gives four Wallfacers vast resources to devise secret plans. One of them is Luo Ji, an unambitious astronomer who does not know why he was chosen. The book builds toward an answer to why a universe full of civilisations is silent.

tezka-planeta.blurb: Seventeen classic science-fiction stories chosen around the scientific problems they dramatise, each followed by the compiler's short commentary on the real science behind it. Authors include Weinbaum, Heinlein, Clarke, Clement, Niven, Piper and Asimov himself.

typhonsky-pakt.blurb: Starfleet Intelligence sends two genetically enhanced agents, Julian Bashir and Sarina Douglas, to infiltrate a rival power and destroy its stolen slipstream-drive project, while a starship waits to extract them.

utek-z-arestonu.blurb: Four years in the orbital prison Areston have changed Srsen, who has survived betrayals and the whims of the powerful and emerges knowing secrets almost nobody shares.

utek-z-teritoria-smrti.blurb: Twenty years after martial law and the resettlement camps, three sixteen-year-old boys in the Republic of the True America discover what the camps are really for and run.

utopie.blurb: A traveller met in Antwerp first criticises the laws and rulers of Europe, then describes at length the island commonwealth of Utopia, its property arrangements, laws, work, war and religion.
utopie.pitch: A traveller met in Antwerp first criticises the laws and rulers of Europe, then describes the island commonwealth of Utopia, organised on reason with no private property. The idea fits in a phrase and is the whole book, argued into place by a first half asking whether hanging thieves can repair a society that manufactures them. Short and full of ideas, it leaves you something to argue about.

uvezneni-v-robloxu.blurb: Three schoolchildren who play an online game are sucked into it by a rigged roulette and must survive a series of mini-games as avatars to escape.

v-tajne-sluzbe-koruny-ceske.blurb: A century after the oceans rose, the war between the Czecho-Slovak Kingdom and Tsarist Russia has stalled and both sides are rearming. The Czecho-Slovak port of Dresden fills with workers and sailors, and with saboteurs and spies, amid friction between Czechs, Germans and Russian immigrants.

ve-jmenu-zitrka.blurb: A man hides in a hole he has dug, hunted by machines that have killed most of the human population and whose origin he does not know. Between attempts to survive he remembers setting out on honeymoon in Italy with his wife.

vesmirna-zasilkovna.blurb: Nori, a boy bored on his family's base in the TRAPPIST-1 system, borrows a ship and ends up accidentally aboard the only delivery vessel of Gryfon's Express Space Courier Service. Gryfon bends the galactic rules on parcel transport, shortening routes and occasionally travelling against the flow of time.

vestcuv-rok.blurb: Will Dando, an unremarkable New York bassist, wakes from a dream knowing 108 things that will happen, and begins publishing them anonymously as the Oracle while the world tries to find out who he is.
vestcuv-rok.pitch: Will Dando, an unremarkable New York bassist, wakes knowing 108 things that will happen and starts publishing them anonymously as the Oracle. The book is the consequences: forecasts that come true however anyone tries to prevent them, and corporations, governments and a church closing in. Kirkus calls it a satire of behaviour and causality.

vichry-duny.blurb: After Paul Atreides' death, his mother Jessica returns to Arrakis for the funeral while his sister Alia rules as regent and a former friend of Paul's turns against the family.

vladce-arestonu.blurb: Areston takes on new prisoners and sets off again while Srsen and his allies decipher the code to its sealed core, and a newcomer seizes half the object by force and manipulation.

vlci-zimy.blurb: Years after nuclear wars and a lethal flu, Lynn McBride survives with what remains of her family in the frozen Yukon, until the arrival of a stranger named Jax brings the secrets of why they fled there in the first place.

vymereny-cas.blurb: As the planet loses its magnetosphere and order breaks down, a professor hides his daughter in a remote prison, where she takes a job as its psychologist. A mismatched group is assembled for a journey to save life, and someone among them is trying to wreck the expedition.

vyslani.blurb: Six girls and six boys fly to Mars aboard a single ship in separate quarters, permitted six minutes together a week under constant cameras, and must each choose the partner they will spend the rest of their life with. Leonor, eighteen and an orphan, is one of the twelve contestants in the televised Genesis programme.

zakalena.blurb: In 2062 Jenny Casey, a maimed Canadian special-forces veteran living rough in Hartford, is pulled back toward the military programme that rebuilt her when a drug developed in secret for the army starts killing local children.

zeme-trva.blurb: A graduate student recovering from a snakebite in the California mountains comes home to find a pandemic has emptied the country. He spends the rest of his life among the handful of survivors and their children, watching what remains of civilisation come apart.
zeme-trva.pitch: A student comes home from a snakebite in the California mountains to find the country emptied by pandemic, and the book follows what happens once nobody tends the water, power, cattle, roads and ants, and above all what happens to knowledge. The idea fits in a phrase: civilisation is a habit, not an achievement.

zeme-v-troskach.blurb: Generations after humanity built cities on vast pillars to escape a collapsing world, an expedition from a Slavic city descends to the surface to recover what could let people take Earth back from the predatory Cizinci.

zeme.blurb: Thirty years after their television-magnate father set them a game of hidden keys, one of his children is still trying to finish it. Her search connects to eight contestants in a show that promises to cut them off from the world forever, and it leads to Iceland.

zjizvena.blurb: Back in Canadian service at fifty, Jenny Casey is chosen to pilot the starship Montreal in search of a habitable world, while on Earth the rivalry between Canada, a corporate contractor and PanChina turns catastrophic.

zkouska-ohnem.blurb: Facing his own death, James Kirk lives inside the Nexus, a place assembled from his own memories, before being drawn out for one last mission that goes wrong.

klam.blurb: Gillian Grayson sets out to avenge her father's death at the hands of the Cerberus organisation, while an assassin steals a DNA-targeted bioweapon design and Admiral Anderson and Kahlee Sanders prepare to address the Citadel Council.

strastiplna-roboti-existence.blurb: In a snowbound North America long after humanity, the explorer robot Meriwether is trapped under an avalanche and the timid scientist robot William is his only hope; an accident on their flight from their own civilisation separates the pair.

2001-vesmirna-odysea-rajske-fontany.blurb: In the first novel a black monolith teaches a starving man-ape to use tools, and three million years later a crew follows its signal outward with a computer that decides the mission matters more than the men. In the second, an engineer sets out to build a cable from a mountain-top monastery to geostationary orbit.
2001-vesmirna-odysea-rajske-fontany.pitch: Two idea-first novels in one volume. The first asks where intelligence comes from, from a monolith teaching a starving man-ape to use tools to a crew following its signal outward. The second takes one capability, a cable to orbit, and follows it out into engineering, politics, weather and money.

arcizar.blurb: Vern, once Wyvern Lord Highfire and perhaps the last dragon alive, hides in the Louisiana swamps until a fifteen-year-old boy on the run from a murderous constable becomes his reluctant helper.

beh-o-zivot.blurb: In a totalitarian, impoverished 2025 America, unemployed Ben Richards enters the state network's most popular game show, in which a contestant is declared an enemy of the state and hunted, to earn money for his sick daughter's medicine.
beh-o-zivot.pitch: Ben Richards, blackballed and desperate for medicine for his sick daughter, signs up for the state network's most popular show, a televised hunt in which he is the quarry. Very short chapters and a countdown keep it moving, with the same pace you liked in The Hunger Games, and a sharp idea about how a society is made to consent.

cesta-na-okraj.blurb: Ensign John Grimes takes passage aboard a merchant starship on his way to his first Survey Service posting and finds himself in his first action instead.

doctor-who.blurb: Eleven short stories by different authors, each featuring one of the eleven television incarnations of the Doctor, published for the programme's fiftieth anniversary.

faktor-nanebevzeti.blurb: Twenty-five years on, the ocean world Pandora is ruled by a clone Director whose regime drives desperate settlers to revolt; the rebels' hope rests on Crista Galli, a woman who emerged from the planet's sentient kelp and whom many take for a divine child.

hrdinove-ceskych-zemi.blurb: Eleven stories set in an alternate world where a mid-nineteenth-century catastrophe drowned and erased whole countries, and the Czech-Slovak kingdom that emerged became a colonial naval power, ranging from the disaster's aftermath to wars a century later.

jama.blurb: In the early Soviet Union a crew of workers digs an enormous foundation pit for a house meant to hold all the country's proletarians, joined by a dismissed factory worker looking for the meaning of existence and by an orphan girl the men adopt as the future they are digging for.

kosmicke-proudy.blurb: A man with no memory is found in the kyrt fields of the exploited planet Florina and slowly recovers what he once knew: a spatio-analyst's warning that Florina's sun is about to explode. Sark, Trantor and Florina's own overseers all have reasons to keep that quiet.

lod-na-milion-let.blurb: Eleven people scattered across the ancient world discover they do not age, and over five thousand years they hide, search for one another, finally gather in the modern day, reveal themselves, and leave on a starship.
lod-na-milion-let.pitch: Eleven people scattered across the ancient world discover they do not age. Over five thousand years the book follows what that does to a person: hiding from neighbours who notice, accusations of witchcraft, outliving every family you make, searching for anyone else like you. It states its idea and carries it through, the way Project Hail Mary does, and leaves you something to think about.

moznost-ostrova.blurb: A famous and deliberately offensive comedian recounts two failed love affairs and his growing involvement with a sect that promises immortality through cloning; his memoir is read and commented on by two of his own clones two thousand years later.

na-komete.blurb: A comet grazes the Earth and carries off a fragment of the Mediterranean along with its air and thirty-six people, who work out where they are and survive the journey out past Saturn and back.

nadace-a-rise.blurb: The Foundation faces two threats to Hari Seldon's predicted future: an Imperial general who still knows how to fight, and then a mutant warlord called the Mule who can convert the emotions of anyone he meets.
nadace-a-rise.pitch: The Foundation faces two threats to Hari Seldon's foreseen future: an Imperial general who still knows how to fight, and then a mutant warlord called the Mule who can convert the emotions of anyone he meets. The book stress-tests its own central claim twice instead of protecting it, the quality you valued in Golden Son.

neviditelny.blurb: An unemployed man in his late thirties, separated from his wife and about to lose his house, accidentally utters a phrase that makes him invisible, and sets about using it - until other people start finding out.

otcove-prstenu.blurb: Short fantasy fiction published before The Hobbit, gathered by a Tolkien scholar as a survey of the writers and traditions that preceded and influenced modern fantasy.

posledni-pan-prstenu.blurb: The War of the Ring retold from Mordor's side: an army medic and a scout survive the defeat and are sent on a mission to destroy the elves' seeing-artefacts and end magic in Middle-earth.
posledni-pan-prstenu.pitch: The war of the Ring retold from Mordor's side, using the terms and geography you already know from The Lord of the Rings: an army medic and a scout survive the defeat and are sent to destroy the elves' seeing-artefacts and end magic in Middle-earth. The book is built on one idea: the war was written by its winners, and the side called evil was the civilisation that bet on rational knowledge.

povidky-podivnych.blurb: Ten fairy tales from the invented folklore of the 'peculiar' people, presented as collected and footnoted by the scholar Millard Nullings, with full-page illustrations in place of the parent series' found photographs.

psi-zima.blurb: The hexer Lota and her vampire lover Urian are punished by her guild for the pairing, and she is forced out of the School just as bands of shapeshifters begin moving on the towns through a hard winter.

rej-stinu.blurb: Twenty-six writers contribute new stories written in tribute to Ray Bradbury, each followed by a short personal note about him, with an introductory essay by Bradbury himself.

sin-slavy-mistru-fantasy.blurb: The first Czech volume of an anthology of classic fantasy short stories, selected by a vote of professional American science fiction and fantasy writers and edited by Robert Silverberg.

stravaganza.blurb: Lucien, a London teenager weakened by cancer treatment, falls asleep holding a marbled notebook and wakes in Bellezza, a city like sixteenth-century Venice, where he becomes caught up in a plot on the Duchessa's life.
stravaganza.pitch: Lucien, a London teenager weakened by cancer treatment, falls asleep holding a marbled notebook and wakes in Bellezza, a city like sixteenth-century Venice, caught up in a plot on the Duchessa's life. A boy whose waking life is illness and whose other life is health gives his wanting something a real engine.

svata-valka-kterou-vedl-saddaj-s-diabole.blurb: The town of Mansoul, built by King Shaddai, is talked into rebellion by Diabolus and crowns him instead; Shaddai sends captains and then his son Emmanuel to besiege and retake it, after which the townsmen lapse again and must petition for help a second time.

svet-na-konci-casu.blurb: A colony expedition arrives at a new star system only to find the star being driven across the cosmos in a war between immortal plasma intelligences; Viktor Sorricaine is frozen and revived again and again as the settlement changes over thousands of years.

svet-uzasny-jako-kapka-jedu.blurb: A representative selection of Zdenek Volny's science fiction short stories, assembled from his collections Nedele na prodej and Zlata past plna casu together with pieces previously published only in magazines.

terra-nullius.blurb: An anthology of Czech science-fiction stories on transhumanism, ranging over secret services, biotechnology, dangerous archaeology, the edge of the solar system and a planned interstellar expedition, with human, alien, robot and animal protagonists.

tolkien-a-jeho-tajemny-svet.blurb: A short illustrated introduction to J. R. R. Tolkien's invented world, covering his best-known books, his philological background and the languages he built, and a selection of the characters and creatures of Middle-earth.

tri-okamziky-exploze.blurb: Twenty-eight stories of weird and speculative fiction, including a besieged London under a sky of floating icebergs, sunken oil rigs that rise and walk onto land, and an anatomy student who finds intricate designs carved inside a cadaver's bones.

vampyrska-akademie.blurb: Marked for the undead vampires she has killed, Rose Hathaway leaves her academy and her duty to the last Dragomir princess and travels abroad to hunt the guardian she loved, who has been turned, while the princess's own troubles continue back at school.

veda-na-zemeplose.blurb: A librarian who cares about the truth of words is drawn into a dispute on the Discworld, where the wizards who accidentally created our universe face legal action from a religion claiming their god-like act mocks it; chapters of the story alternate with science chapters by a mathematician and a biologist.

vetrelci.blurb: Eighteen short stories about the Colonial Marines of the Alien films fighting xenomorphs in deep space, on colony worlds and inside the hive.

zaklinacka-lota.blurb: A set of linked stories tracing the hexer Lota from her conception to the events immediately preceding the novel that follows, in a pseudo-medieval world where hexers fight monsters and each other.

zakon-genu.blurb: A collection of Czech science fiction short stories published for the two-hundredth anniversary of the birth of Gregor Mendel, under the patronage of Nobel laureate Paul Nurse.

zkazky-z-planety-zeme.blurb: Fourteen science-fiction stories by Arthur C. Clarke, all set on or around the Earth, each with an author's note, ranging from deep-sea farming to a wall of darkness at the edge of a world.

protovy-svety.blurb: Prot, a psychiatric patient who insists he comes from the planet K-PAX and is on Earth to report on it, returns to the Manhattan Psychiatric Institute, and his psychiatrist records their sessions and their effect on the other patients.

rok-pote.blurb: Two years after an EMP attack destroyed American electronics, John Matherson's mountain town faces raiding bands of survivalists and a newly formed federal government that arrives with a draft and a demand for obedience.

ze-zeme-na-mesic.blurb: After the Civil War a Baltimore club of artillery enthusiasts resolves to fire a projectile at the Moon, and three men decide to ride inside it. The book follows the design, funding and casting of the gun and ends with the shot fired.

100-chyb-pri-peci-o-lidi-s-demenci.blurb: A practical guide for carers of people with dementia, organised as a hundred common mistakes; each entry states an assumption the authors disagree with, then explains how to avoid it.

101-tipu-jak-vychovat-poslusneho-a-spoko.blurb: A dog-training handbook of numbered exercises covering basic obedience, house manners and common behaviour problems.

130-h-z-a-o.blurb: A Czech science-fiction comic whose scenes are cut like a blockbuster film, set in a world where good fights evil and science is set against faith.

150-terapeutickych-her-pro-dospivajici.blurb: A practical collection of 150 recreation-therapy games and activities for use with teenagers, aimed at building self-esteem, communication and coping skills, each with discussion prompts.

ala-luna.blurb: After technological progress leaves Earth devastated and much of humanity moves to lunar colonies, Sam Frank puts to sea with the crew of a salvage freighter on the day of a chemical attack, and is carried somewhere he never expected.

alexandr-veliky.blurb: A novel combining a brain-implanted artificial intelligence with the archetypal foundations of human nature, in which superhuman forces at work inside a man drive the plot to an unexpected resolution.

apokalypsa-evropy.blurb: On an ordinary winter day in Prague an unknown radiation kills everyone who was not somehow shielded, leaving under five percent of the population alive across half the world. The survivors organise themselves and face light, water, food, an invasion threat and the question of what a nation is now built on.

arabella-z-marsu.blurb: In an 1813 where sailing ships cross the interplanetary aether, Arabella Ashby, raised on a Mars plantation and moved to England, disguises herself as a boy to work a Mars-bound ship and reach her brother before a cousin can seize the family estate.

arthur-a-minimojove.blurb: Ten-year-old Arthur finds an old travel journal and a message in his grandfather's library and crosses into the realm of the tiny Minimoys, whose help he needs to save his grandmother's house from a swindler.

besna-zem.blurb: In the near future the Czech state and its structures have collapsed, and the surviving towns and communities hold out on their own while powerful corporations take over infrastructure and offer protection in exchange for loyalty. The route the story follows runs from central Bohemia to Ostrava.

bizarni-cesko.blurb: A guide to over a hundred odd, surprising or bizarre places around the Czech Republic, drawn from the author's long-running travel column.

bozi-milost.blurb: Calvin Cohn, a Jewish palaeontologist, survives a nuclear holocaust in a submersible and finds the earth flooded and himself the last man, with God telling him he lives only through a minuscule error. On an island he teaches a group of chimpanzees speech and human virtue, fathers a child with one of them, and is destroyed by the community he made.

bronzova-planeta-a-jina-reseni.blurb: A selection of the author's own science-fiction short stories, on themes ranging across the universe, humanity and the individual.

byl-jednou-jeden-ul.blurb: An illustrated children's story about the world of a beehive, following young bees from hatching through their first exploration, a visit from the queen and an encounter with the beekeeper.
byl-jednou-jeden-ul.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-09-03)

cerna-flotila.blurb: In the 25th century, faster-than-light travel has given humanity hundreds of colonised worlds and centuries without war, leaving its warships obsolete. Captain Jackson Wolfe takes an aging destroyer out with a new executive officer he distrusts and a bureaucrat aboard.

chlapec-a-jeho-robot.blurb: Sixth-grader Code Lightfall falls into Mekhos, a machine world built and abandoned by an ancient civilisation, and travels with a speck-sized robot and a giant atomic one in search of the Robonomicon and his missing grandfather.

co-te-nezabije.blurb: An investigative journalist trains in Wim Hof's cold-exposure and breathing method, from a sceptical start to climbing Kilimanjaro bare-chested, and reports the physiology claimed for environmental conditioning.

dech.blurb: After the Switch stripped the atmosphere, survivors live in domes selling manufactured air. Quinn, a privileged Premium, and Bea, an Auxiliary, leave the pod on a camping trip and meet Alina, a rebel replanting trees outside.

dejiny-italie.blurb: A single-volume history of Italy from the tenth century to the twentieth, covering the communes, foreign domination, the Risorgimento, Fascism and the postwar republic.

diagnostika-syndromu-tyraneho-zneuzivane.blurb: A Czech-Slovak professional handbook on recognising and diagnosing child abuse and neglect syndrome, drawing on medicine, therapeutic pedagogy, social work and psychology, including a chapter on diagnosis through children's drawings.

dinotopie.blurb: A nineteenth-century naturalist and his young son are shipwrecked on a hidden island where humans and intelligent dinosaurs live as one society, and his illustrated journal records their travels through it.

dite-a-prirodni-zakony.blurb: A French educator sets out what she takes to be the natural laws of a child's development, drawing on Montessori practice and on her own experiment in a state nursery class, and describes how a classroom and an adult's behaviour should be arranged around them.

divky-od-svate-magdaleny.blurb: Dublin, 1962: sixteen-year-old Teagan is sent to a Magdalen laundry run by nuns after a young priest's confession of desire for her, and with two other girls endures forced labour and punishment while looking for a way out.

do-pekla-a-zpet.blurb: In 2028 a government assassin known as Strasak is sent into an autonomous zone used as a prison for the worst repeat offenders, to extract a missing agent, and is drawn into a secret-services operation in which everyone is expendable.

dobrodruzstvi-minecraftu.blurb: Josh, Andre and Suzy enter a Minecraft world built as a replica of the real one while tracking Herobrine, and stop at a walled city under siege by creepers.

dokonaly-par.blurb: In a society that assigns each seventeen-year-old a lifelong partner, Cassia is matched with her best friend Xander, then sees another boy's face flicker on the official screen.

dokonaly-sen.blurb: Cassia searches the outer provinces for Ky, who was sent there among the unfit to die, and learns he escaped into wild canyons; the narration alternates between the two of them.

dokonaly-svet.blurb: Cassia, Ky and Xander narrate in turn as a plague spreads through the Society and a rebellion tries to produce a cure, each of them having to give up what they most want.

dosel-nam-cas.blurb: Humanity has grown used to an easy modern life when one day the lights fail for good; within days unease becomes a fight for bare survival, and the city can no longer be lived in.

dospele-deti-emocne-nezralych-rodicu.blurb: A non-fiction guide describing types of emotionally immature parents and the effects on their adult children, with strategies for recognising the pattern and setting boundaries.

dum-zelenych-prizraku.blurb: A scientist becomes uncritically absorbed in his own technical invention, and the novel follows what happens when it is misused. The 1999 Czech volume prints it together with a second novel in which the author instead trusts technology to solve every human problem.

duveruj-zitrku.blurb: Christine leaves home for a promising job in the city, then has to weigh the career against caring for her family after a misfortune, while deciding which of several suitors she wants.

dvojnik.blurb: After his wife drowns when their car is swept off a flooded road, Dylan Moran keeps seeing himself, and a psychiatrist tells him that every choice he has made spawned a parallel world - and that one version of him is hunting the others, killing those closest to them.

elias-mezi-lidojedy.blurb: The one-handed cabin boy Elias, Angelika and their friends sail after Captain Flint's dragon pearls to the Island of Dragon's Blood, where a legendary bird with flaming wings is said to live, past sirens, cannibals and a sea monster.
elias-mezi-lidojedy.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-09-03)

epistoly-o-elitach-a-lidu.blurb: A collection of short essays by a Czech historian on how elites and the common people have been conceived through history and how that division looks in the present day.

evropske-panovnicke-rody.blurb: A popular history of nineteenth-century European royal and imperial courts organised around their scandals: arranged marriages, secret relationships, mistreated children and the rise of the gossip press.

financni-analyza.blurb: A Czech textbook on company financial analysis: reading financial statements, ratio and value-based indicators, and worked examples from real accounts.

girgal.blurb: Girgal, a genetically engineered intelligent dog, escapes Earth and lands on a planet of auk-like beings whose civilisation he tries first to raise and later to save.

h2o-a-poklad-sileneho-oka.blurb: Three schoolchildren armed with a shrinking device pursue a treasure through Prague's gothic underground and a robbery at the state bank, against the recurring villain professor Vulpes.
h2o-a-poklad-sileneho-oka.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-09-03)

h2o-a-zahada-zlate-slzy.blurb: Three friends search an ancient library for a secret chamber holding a baroque alchemist's invention, the Golden Tear, and use it to travel into space and discover a counter-Earth.

horecka.blurb: Eleven months after a virus killed most of the world's population, thirteen-year-old Nico Storm and his father Willem cross a ruined South Africa and found a settlement called Amanzi; Nico narrates from decades later, opening by announcing that his father was murdered.
horecka.pitch: Eleven months after a virus has killed most of the world, thirteen-year-old Nico and his father cross South Africa to found a settlement. Decades later Nico tells how his father's open vision for a rebuilt society clashed with a creed that men are animals, with the boy pulled between them. The society grows believably from food and warmth to raiders to rival factions.

hostitel.blurb: Earth has been taken over by a parasitic alien species that occupies human bodies, and the soul implanted in Melanie Stryder finds that her host refuses to fade, so the two of them go looking for the people Melanie loves.
hostitel.pitch: Earth is taken over by a parasitic species, and the soul implanted in Melanie Stryder finds that her host refuses to fade. Two minds share one body and argue, so nearly every page is about what one of them wants and why the other resists. It opens with an alien waking up implanted in a captured woman.

hudba-pro-anvilany.blurb: Prague 2030. Years after a financial crash, EnerClad rises from the ruins of the national power company, terraforms planets and broadcasts its own space television. On Earth an apparition appears in the control room of a nuclear plant.

hvezdny-hrad.blurb: Northern France, 1869: a year after Claire Dulac disappears in a balloon at the edge of space searching for aether, her husband and son are summoned to the Bavarian king's fairy-tale castle, where a secret spacecraft is being built.

jak-draha-je-nepoctivost.blurb: A behavioural-economics account of everyday dishonesty, arguing from experiments that most people cheat by small amounts when conditions allow it and rationalise the result.

jak-se-uspesne-ucit-s-adhd.blurb: A practical guide for parents of children with ADHD or ADD, offering methods for homework, concentration, organisation, motivation and cooperation with the school.

jumper-griffinuv-pribeh.blurb: Griffin O'Connor can teleport to any place he has been, a secret his parents made him swear to keep. At nine he watches men murder them, and he spends his adolescence hunted by the people who want him dead.

karantena.blurb: In 2034 an impenetrable bubble encloses the solar system. Decades later a private investigator with a headful of neural mods is hired to find a woman who walked out of a locked institution through the walls, and the trail leads to the people who worked out why the bubble is there.
karantena.pitch: A bubble seals off the solar system, and decades later a private investigator with a head full of neural mods is hired to find a woman who walked out of a locked institution through the walls. One precise idea is built out to its biggest consequence, the question of why something sealed the solar system off, and each step follows from the last.

kazdy-je-na-neco-chytry.blurb: A guide for children aged about eight to twelve, based on Howard Gardner's theory of multiple intelligences, helping them identify which of eight kinds of intelligence are their strengths and use them to improve elsewhere.

klid-pred-bouri.blurb: Henry, taken in by the Delaney family as a boy, follows his adoptive father into the Royal Canadian Mounted Police, then has to balance that posting against his feelings for a young widow and her son.

kognitivni-trenink-pro-treti-vek.blurb: A Czech handbook of cognitive and memory training exercises aimed at older adults and at those working with memory decline and dementia.

komu-se-da-verit.blurb: A non-fiction account of how trust works, arguing it has shifted from personal to institutional to distributed forms mediated by technology, illustrated with platforms, blockchain, the darknet and China's social credit system.

kostelik-ktery-se-radoval.blurb: In a small village church, two children, Anička and Jiřík, are introduced by the Virgin Mary to Czech and other saints, each of whom teaches them about a virtue.
kostelik-ktery-se-radoval.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-09-03)

laska-prichazi-po-spickach.blurb: Marty arrives on the frontier newly married and pregnant; when her husband is killed she accepts a neighbouring farmer's offer of a marriage in name only, in return for shelter and the care of his two-year-old daughter.

ledova-generace.blurb: In 2023 alien craft appear worldwide and give humanity thirty days to reach Antarctica, the only place it will be permitted to exist. In the settlements that follow, scientists engineer a new kind of human able to survive the cold.

literatura-a-politika.blurb: A translated collection of literary-critical essays examining the relationship between literature and politics through twelve models, mainly on Central European authors writing under and after totalitarian regimes.

londyn.blurb: A Czech translation of the DK Eyewitness Top 10 guide to London: themed top-ten lists of sights, museums, parks, shops and places to eat, with maps.

lovci.blurb: In Prague in 2050, senior inspector Petr Mlejnek serves in a federal unit that hunts genetically and cybernetically enhanced criminals, until an operation against a villain called Spider goes wrong.

mag.blurb: Pug, taken as a slave through a rift to the world of Kelewan, spends years in captivity before the empire's Great Ones recognise his talent and train him as a master magician; he returns to Midkemia in time for the war between the two worlds to be decided.

magicke-dite.blurb: A non-fiction argument that children develop through a natural sequence of stages which modern childbirth, parenting and schooling disrupt, tracing later psychological and social harm to those interruptions.

malevil.blurb: A handful of people drinking wine in the cellar of a restored medieval keep in rural France survive a nuclear detonation, and the narrator records how they feed themselves, arm themselves and decide who governs them afterwards.
malevil.pitch: A handful of people in the cellar of a medieval keep survive a nuclear blast, and the narrator records how they feed, arm and govern themselves: seed grain, the last two mares, who owns the guns, who may be priest. It is mostly men and women stating what they want and why. His account is even footnoted and contradicted by another survivor.

malirky.blurb: A survey of forty-eight women painters, famous and forgotten, from the Renaissance to the present, including artists from the indigenous populations of colonised countries, presented as an introduction to art history through their lives.

matematika-nas-bavi.blurb: A book of mathematical facts, puzzles and experiments for young readers, covering numbers and geometry.

mechanicke-rybicky.blurb: Two mechanical fish travel the seas, and their journey reveals the ecological damage done to the planet by people and by nature itself.

metalstory.blurb: An old man escapes a home for retired secret agents, is shot dead at Tiwanaku, and wakes into a conflict on the distant planet Pu-ma where thought and metal are the decisive powers.

mihotani.blurb: A Polish reporter spends three months in Siorapaluk and Qaanaaq, the northernmost inhabited settlements in Greenland, describing the daily life, hunting and history of the world's most northerly Inuit under Danish rule.

mijamoto-musasi.blurb: In old Japan a boy from the village of Miyamoto trains in the way of the sword, tests himself against fearsome opponents and, after his victory over Sasaki Kojiro, withdraws into the forests of Echizen to seek out a hermit and put his doubts about the meaning of his path to him.
mijamoto-musasi.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-09-03)

moje-adhd-ma-uzkosti.blurb: A cognitive behavioural therapy workbook for adults whose ADHD is accompanied by anxiety, with chapter exercises on worry and rumination, focus, avoidance, procrastination and rejection sensitivity.

muj-bratr-mesias.blurb: In 2096, after years of drought, a boy called Eli is born in Prague during the first rain; decades later his older brother preaches Eli's message to survivors of a mass exodus, carrying the burden of a new faith.

navrat-krale-sumavy.blurb: In 1948 Josef Hasil joins the Czechoslovak border guard tasked with stopping escapes to the West, and gradually begins helping people across instead.

navrat-na-ostrov-kamelii.blurb: Sylvia and Mael are expecting their long-awaited child on the Breton camellia island when his mother, whom he has not spoken to in nearly thirty years, falls seriously ill and he leaves for the mainland. A storm flood then devastates the coast and the island, and Sylvia is badly injured.

navstevnici.blurb: In 2484 a global council learns of a body approaching Earth and sends an expedition back to 1984 to recover the school notebooks of a boy who worked out a principle for moving continents; the scientists arrive in a small Czech town posing as geologists.

nebezpecny-pacient.blurb: A veterinarian working a night shift at an isolated animal clinic is forced by masked men to operate on a badly wounded man; her daughter is then taken to keep her quiet, and she turns to the girl's father, a former dealer, for help.

nebojte-se-zmen.blurb: A Czech coach and therapist writes about the fear that accompanies life changes and how to work with it rather than avoid it, drawing on her practice with burnout, self-confidence and trauma.

nemrtvi.blurb: An illustration manual: materials and basic technique, then a section of thirty undead portraits with original sketches, detail studies and step-by-step workflows, plus ways of depicting stages of decay.

neviditelni-zlodeji.blurb: Eight science-fiction stories by young Czech authors, set on Earth and on distant future worlds, each extrapolating how people behave under conditions remade by science and technology.
neviditelni-zlodeji.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-09-03)

neviditelni.blurb: Forty years after a Great Reset, everyone's only possession is an implanted biochip that scores their conformity and governs where they may live and work; a young graduate content with the new order meets a man who has no chip.

neztrat-mapu-k-memu-srdci.blurb: Lorin needs a flatmate to cover the cost of renovating her flat and ends up sharing with Ben, a pyrotechnician colleague who has kept everyone at arm's length and has secrets of his own to trade for hers.

nikdy-nedelej-kompromis-aneb-vyjednavej-.blurb: A former FBI lead international kidnapping negotiator sets out the techniques he used in hostage cases - tactical empathy, labelling, mirroring, calibrated questions - and argues they apply to ordinary business and personal negotiation.
nikdy-nedelej-kompromis-aneb-vyjednavej-.pitch: A former FBI kidnapping negotiator sets out the techniques he used in hostage cases, tactical empathy, labelling, mirroring, calibrated questions, and argues they apply in business and everyday life. It is about what people want and why, with concrete case material from real kidnappings, and the idea comes down to one phrase: get inside the other side's fears.

nota-bene.blurb: An illustrated book for young readers explaining where well-known Latin sayings come from and what they mean.

nova-gaia.blurb: A science-fiction gamebook set in 2342 in which the reader, playing a celebrated astronaut on Mars, must uncover a conspiracy and stop a larger threat approaching the planet.

odmaturuj-z-literatury.blurb: A Czech school-leaving-exam revision guide to literature: periods, movements, authors and set texts in summary form, with practice questions.

operace-slunce.blurb: Humanity has settled the Solar System when a mafia-run corporation hires a former space pilot to steal a doomsday weapon the Earth government intends to dispose of by firing it into the Sun.

pan-blesku.blurb: A novel about the young Nikola Tesla, from his studies and inventing in old Prague through his years around Edison and Westinghouse, with Guglielmo Marconi cast as both closest friend and rival.

pan-tompkins-stale-v-risi-divu.blurb: C. G. H. Tompkins, a bank clerk, dozes through popular physics lectures and dreams himself into worlds where the speed of light is a bicycle's pace, quantum effects are visible at human scale, and the universe is born and dies.
pan-tompkins-stale-v-risi-divu.pitch: A bank clerk dozes through popular physics lectures and dreams himself into worlds where the speed of light is a bicycle's pace and quantum effects are visible at human scale. Each dream lets you live inside a physics regime instead of being told about it: length contraction, quantum indeterminacy, the birth and death of the universe, black holes and quarks.

pekelna-dira.blurb: General Adolphus, exiled after a failed rebellion to a ruined planet used as a dumping ground, builds a power base among the frontier worlds while colonists discover that the planet's extinct natives survive as consciousnesses able to merge with humans.

piseme-pribeh.blurb: A teacher's resource of worksheets and lessons that walks young primary-school pupils through planning and writing a short story: characters, setting, problem and ending.

pisen-kterou-se-objasnuje-svet.blurb: Twenty-two horror and speculative stories in which characters lose their grip on what they are seeing - a father who has kidnapped his daughter loses her in a boarded-up house, survivors live in holes beneath a tower, doubles and sensory anomalies recur.

pod-znamenim-pulmesice.blurb: Between 2049 and 2070 almost all of Europe lives under Muslim rule that is beginning to crumble from internal strain. Parallel strands follow refugees from Italy, Bohemia, the Baltics, Germany and a conquered Israel who refuse to submit and leave to found islands of a restored civilisation.

podivne-nebe-nad-vychodnim-berlinem.blurb: In 1973 a mysterious craft falls near East Berlin and the Soviet army begins a secret investigation. Herring, an American agent embedded in the Stasi and long since tired of his own cover, is sent to find out what they have, and discovers it is already inside their minds.

podraz.blurb: A former US federal agent's account of going undercover as a money launderer in Panama and inside the Cali cartel, as seized shipments and a blown cover identity put him in danger.

posledni-follower.blurb: In a 2044 run by robots and addictive technology, ecological resisters led by three legendary YouTubers are hunted and vanish. Fourteen-year-old Max sets out to find them and becomes the last follower.

povidky-o-vlasti.blurb: A collection of satirical short stories about post-Soviet Russia, some of them shaped as political thrillers, setting real against declared patriotism and power against people. The title plays ironically on the Soviet tradition of short celebratory prose.

povstani-herobrina.blurb: Josh, Andre and Suzy discover superhero abilities inside the Minecraft world and must cross a dragon territory on the way to the city of Silverrock.

pravidla-kterymi-se-vase-matka-neridila.blurb: A follow-up to The Rules, giving women thirty-one rules for dating in the age of texting, Facebook and online dating, co-written with the authors' daughters.

pravidla-valky.blurb: Captain Jack Steel leads his grenadiers at Ramillies in 1706 under the Duke of Marlborough, then is sent undercover into the Low Countries to root out traitors and prepare the way to the French-held port of Ostend.

prekonavani-traumatu.blurb: A workbook for trauma survivors and their therapists, explaining trauma symptoms as normal survival responses and offering diagrams and worksheets for working with them.

prevoznik.blurb: On the hidden archipelago of Prospera, citizens live well until their implanted monitors fall below ten percent and they ferry to the Nursery to be renewed. Proctor Bennett, who escorts them, begins to dream, watches his own monitor fall, and hears his father say a word nobody can explain.
prevoznik.pitch: On the hidden archipelago of Prospera, citizens live well until a forearm monitor falls below ten percent and they are ferried to the Nursery to be renewed. Proctor Bennett, the ferryman, is assigned to take his own father to the boat, then begins to dream and watches his own monitor fall. The rules are the heart of it, and the book asks what they follow from.

pribehy-velkych-mest.blurb: A multi-author survey of sixty-eight cities from Uruk and Memphis to Tokyo and Sao Paulo, each given a short illustrated essay on its people, architecture and government.

primo-tady-mezi-vami.blurb: Diaries kept by members of a Collective who look and mostly behave like humans, presented together with the interrogation record of one of them, describing a technology that lets them evade death and an unstable political situation in the galaxy.

promente-uzkost-v-nadeji-pomoci-kbt.blurb: A self-help workbook combining cognitive behavioural therapy with positive psychology, offering exercises intended to replace anxious and negative thinking with optimism and hope.

promeny-kafkovy-prahy.blurb: An anthology of twelve stories by contemporary Czech authors, all tied to Prague and to Franz Kafka, moving between the city's past, its present and science-fictional futures.

prvni-pomoc.blurb: An illustrated household first-aid manual covering injuries, poisonings and sudden illness, with step-by-step procedures and prevention advice.

psychiatricke-minimum.blurb: A Czech psychiatrist explains basic psychiatric concepts and diagnoses for non-medical readers, illustrating each with cases from over thirty years of practice.

psychologie-atkinsonove-a-hilgarda.blurb: A comprehensive introductory psychology textbook covering methodology, the biological basis of behaviour, cognition, emotion, personality, development, social behaviour and psychopathology.

psychologie-reklamy.blurb: A Czech textbook on the psychology of advertising, covering motivation, emotion and perception in consumer response, with analyses of real campaigns.

psychologie-rodiny.blurb: A Czech handbook on family psychology for teachers and helping professionals, following human development through partner choice, parenthood, trauma, abuse, post-divorce care arrangements and substitute family care.

psychopedie.blurb: A Czech special-education textbook on intellectual-development disorders and autistic-spectrum conditions, covering the special pedagogue's role, inclusive schooling, how such pupils present at school, and diagnosis and support.

purgatorium.blurb: On an irreparably devastated far-future Earth, Genesis, a girl who has lost her memory, survives alongside her friends while searching for her past, and discovers that a deadlier enemy stands behind the lethal infection threatening them.

puvod.blurb: A research team in Antarctica finds a mummified modern-looking human body dated to forty thousand years ago. The team is attacked, and the surviving scientist turns to her ex-husband, a former member of an elite government unit, to keep the discovery from being buried.

qualityland.blurb: In a near-future country governed by algorithms, machine scrapper Peter Jobless cannot bring himself to destroy the defective robots sent to him, and sets out to return a product that the world's largest retailer insists he wants.
qualityland.pitch: In a near-future country governed by algorithms, Peter Jobless is a machine scrapper who cannot bring himself to destroy the defective robots sent to him. Then he sets out to return a product the world's largest retailer insists he wants. The idea is stated precisely and carried through, and it forces the whole system to admit it can be wrong.

rec-emoci.blurb: A popular-psychology book arguing that every emotion carries useful information; the first half teaches five empathic skills and the second works through individual emotions such as anger, fear, panic and depression as practical tools.

reinkarnace.blurb: A man regains partial consciousness in an intensive care unit not knowing who he is; on mechanical ventilation and able only to hear and smell, he recovers, when a woman's voice unlocks part of his memory, fragments of two earlier lives.

remo.blurb: Prague taxi driver David Malik goes to a meeting expecting new work and is told by the International Space Agency that he has been chosen for humanity's first contact with an alien civilisation, to take place in a week at his south Bohemian cottage.

rikal-jsem-mu-kravata.blurb: A twenty-year-old Tokyo recluse who has not spoken for two years begins sitting on a park bench, where he gradually falls into conversation with a middle-aged office worker who has been sacked and keeps dressing for work so his wife will not know.
rikal-jsem-mu-kravata.pitch: A twenty-year-old who has not left his room in two years edges back into the world from a park bench, opposite a middle-aged salaryman who has lost his job and cannot tell his wife. It is a short book in very short chapters, in one first-person voice, almost wholly about what two people want and why, and that two failures can restore each other.

rodina-a-spolecnost.blurb: A Czech sociological study text on the family and its relationship to society, issued in an academic teaching series.

rozvijeni-emocni-inteligence-zaku.blurb: A handbook on the emotional and social intelligence of school pupils: how it is assessed, how it relates to negative behaviour and dropout risk, and what school programmes can develop it.

sanctum.blurb: Dan, Abby and Jordan, still haunted by their summer at a former asylum, return to New Hampshire College after anonymous photographs of an old carnival arrive, and find the carnival and the surrounding town hold a history that touches Dan directly.

sejdeme-se-na-piazzete.blurb: Frances Mayes and her husband Ed travel through thirteen regions of Italy, from Friuli to Sicily, describing small towns, food, wine and local history, with recipes between the chapters.

slunce-na-uteku.blurb: A catastrophe of unprecedented scale strikes the world; Mike and Bessy survive it by chance in a shelter in the Rocky Mountains, and after two months emerge into a landscape burned beyond recognition.

snis-o-druhe-zemi.blurb: Ten astronauts leave a dying Earth for a habitable planet in a nearby system: four veterans and six teenagers trained for the mission since childhood. The voyage will take twenty-three years with no one to rely on but each other.

souziti-s-partnerem-po-mrtvici.blurb: A guide for the husbands and wives of stroke survivors, covering the medical consequences, home care, rehabilitation, and the emotional and practical changes to the relationship.

sport-je-bolest.blurb: A sports physiotherapist explains why injuries happen in every sport and how to prevent them, recover faster and keep training for decades, with exercise guidance and links to video demonstrations.

strategicky-management-lidskych-zdroju.blurb: A Czech monograph on strategic human-resource management, covering age management, corporate social responsibility, employer branding, talent management and sustainability, supported by survey and statistical data.

strnaduv-efekt.blurb: Alien portals appear across Earth emitting lethal radiation; a warehouseman who survives one at close range gains alien technology in his body and the power to close them, and becomes the target of the creatures coming through.

stvoritele-budoucnosti.blurb: An anthology of science-fiction and horror short stories by classic authors of those genres, compiled by Peter Haining.

supervedator.blurb: Fourteen-year-old Cosmo Hill escapes an orphanage where boys are used to test dangerous products, and joins a gang of outcast teenagers who can see and destroy the blue creatures that feed on human life force.

svatebni-plan.blurb: Regency England: the bankrupt family of a dead viscount stakes its last money on presenting the prettier sister in London society, with the eldest daughter accompanying her disguised as a widowed chaperone.

tamar.blurb: Given at fourteen to a cruel, idol-worshipping husband, the widowed Tamar is denied the heir her position entitles her to and takes a desperate step to claim it from her father-in-law Judah.

tovarna-na-skorapky.blurb: A millionaire funds the development of a superhuman artificial intelligence called Singularita, and a group of hackers known as the Skorapky set out to stop him, with escalating violence.

tri-socialni-svety.blurb: A Czech sociologist argues that contemporary society is splitting into three mutually incommensurable social worlds - the elite, the middle strata and the declassed - and examines how social science's own concepts hide that shift.
tri-socialni-svety.pitch: A Czech sociologist argues that society has moved from inequality to incommensurability: the elite, the middle strata and the declassed now live in conditions that cannot be measured against each other. It is argued with data and traced to the processes behind it. Then the book turns on its own discipline, arguing that sociology's fashionable vocabulary hides the shift it is meant to describe.

uralske-okno.blurb: Essays by a Finnish writer and journalist on the Uralic and Finno-Ugric minority peoples of Russia, their situation and how they live.

urbo-kune.blurb: A new librarian arrives in Urbo Kune, an invented and never-inhabited capital of a united Europe, and gradually concludes that the city has a secret life and a plan of its own for him.

uz-je-to-tady.blurb: Ten loosely interlinked humorous science-fiction stories about the technologies that could take over everyday life, by a group of Czech and Slovak authors.

v-prazdnote.blurb: Pavel Prochazka wakes from cryosleep on the colonisation ship Destiny with no memory of who he is, the only living person aboard a vessel full of frozen dead, and pieces his identity together with help from the ship's artificial intelligence.

valku-skoncili-skrcci.blurb: A Czech science-fiction novel; the catalogue record gives no plot description.
valku-skoncili-skrcci.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-09-03)

vanice.blurb: A district doctor and his driver set out by horse-drawn sled to deliver vaccine to a distant village during an epidemic, and spend the book lost in a blizzard among increasingly strange encounters.

veda-v-kostce.blurb: An illustrated science encyclopedia for young readers, surveying physics, chemistry, biology, the natural sciences and space.

vepsano-krvi-vlastniho-srdce.blurb: June 1778: the British army withdraws from Philadelphia, Jamie Fraser returns after being presumed drowned to find Claire married to his friend Lord John Grey, and the Frasers are drawn into Washington's army while a parallel twentieth-century thread follows their daughter's family.

vesmirni-pytlaci.blurb: Two children from Earth join a former space marine, a malfunctioning kitchen robot and an intelligent rocket to stop poachers who raid planets for endangered exotic animals and sell them on the black market.

vita-humana.blurb: A young teacher whose life is boringly ordinary meets a mysterious being, and the encounter draws him into a search for where everything and humankind actually came from.

vladana-a-prasopes.blurb: Vladana finishes school on a small planet that is a failed copy of Earth and, rather than cleaning cages, answers an advertisement for an intergalactic guardian - for which she needs the right magical animal.

vymena.blurb: In the mid-twenty-first century an artificial intelligence long out of its creators' control decides to drastically reduce Earth's population, and launches a secret mission into the past to retrieve the key to human survival on another planet.

zapisnik-alkoholicky.blurb: A young mother's account of her alcohol dependence, her detox and the first year of abstinence, assembled from her blog and diary, closing with her family's view of the same events.

zena-ktera-zacala-zit.blurb: A woman living quietly in rural France is called back to England by her estranged father's death and inherits his coded diaries, which force her to confront her own past.

adaptace.blurb: Epidemics and wars have decimated humanity. Zoya, who has lost everything, follows a map toward a city called Ark where the rest of humanity supposedly still lives in peace, travelling with a stranger and his young sister across the ruined land.

literatura.blurb: A survey of Czech and world literature by period for Czech secondary-school students, with excerpts and a section on literary theory, aimed at maturita and university-entrance preparation.

poselstvi-megalitu.blurb: A survey of megalithic monuments from Europe and Malta to Inca fortresses in the Andes, Australia and the South Pacific, asking who built them, how the multi-ton blocks were moved, and what the builders intended.

stoparuv-pruvodce-galaxii-douglase-adams.blurb: A continuation of the Hitchhiker's series written by Eoin Colfer at the request of Douglas Adams's estate, picking up Arthur Dent, Ford Prefect, Zaphod Beeblebrox and Marvin after the events of the fifth book.

projekt-gilgames.blurb: A superintelligent computer, asked by a robopsychologist to define the meaning of human existence, answers with the story of Urshanabi, the immortal ferryman of the Gilgamesh epic, who travels through history seeking to do some good for humanity.
projekt-gilgames.pitch: A superintelligence built to define the meaning of human existence declines to compute an answer and tells a story instead: the ferryman Ursanabi, carried across history from Aristotle to the conquistadors. It is a short book with one nameable idea, and where it lands, on storytelling as the characteristically human act, is worth the trip.

7-prisernych.blurb: An 11-year-old boy accidentally triggers an ancient machine that extracts the seven deadly sins from his soul as small monsters, then flies to Brazil with them to find his missing sister.
7-prisernych.pitch: A boy's seven deadly sins are extracted by an old machine in a cathedral and become small monster companions, and he flies to Brazil with them to find his sister. The wacky plot keeps its own sense of logic, and the idea of your vices as useful companions you argue with is a good one.

amulet.blurb: Emily and her allies charter an airship in search of the lost city of Cielis, gaining an uneasy new companion in the Elf King's son while the Amulet's voice keeps pressing dangerous thoughts on her.
amulet.pitch: Emily and her allies charter an airship to find the lost city of Cielis, taking along the Elf King's son as an uneasy companion while the Amulet's voice keeps pressing dangerous thoughts on her. It opens on mercy and forgiveness, an enemy's stone smashed and the enemy invited along anyway, and reviewers single out trust and forgiveness as real emotional content. Emily wants to protect her family, and she feels real doubt about the cost of the Amulet's power.

bratrstvo-krve.blurb: Jan Bezzemek is a member of the Svabove, vampires who broke clan rules but were spared execution; after a failed mission to kill General Gerhard, they are sent to eliminate Gudrin, a target a twenty-strong vampire special-forces unit already died trying to reach.

cestovni-kancelar-jinosvety.blurb: Flick Hudson, now an official Strangeworlds Travel Agency member, is summoned by a pirate queen whose flat ocean world is collapsing at its edges, and must find her people a new home before time runs out.

den-vosaka.blurb: A satirical short-story collection presenting the misadventures of the arch-villain Vosak, framed as a mock-serious 'translation' of an American pulp author complete with fake scholarly footnotes.

divka-had-trn.blurb: Cursed since birth to poison anyone she touches, Persian princess Soraya strikes a bargain with a captive demon for a cure, and must choose between a human suitor and the demon who truly sees her.

divodejove.blurb: Twelve-year-old Harper is recruited into the Spectaculars, a boarding-school troupe of magical stage performers, and must help save her new school from a looming threat while adjusting to a persecuted, secretive magical world.

filix-wood.blurb: Filix Wood is drawn by an unexplained longing into a hidden forest village whose people believe only the strongest survive, and must decide whether to accept their world's demand for self-sacrifice or find another way.

furyborn.blurb: A prophecy foretells two queens born a thousand years apart, one from blood and one from light, each wielding elemental magic that could decide the world's fate; their stories are told in alternating timelines that eventually converge.

hlad.blurb: When the horseman Famine sweeps through Brazil, he finds Ana, a woman he once left for dead. Their reunion becomes a captivity that turns into an uneasy, brutal romance while the fate of humanity hangs on whether Famine chooses her over his mission.

hodina-dynove-kralovny.blurb: A year into her reign as queen of Halloween Town, Sally falls through a portal into Time Town, where she must find who tampered with the clock controlling her home before she loses it for good.

jak-zradit-draciho-hrdinu.blurb: Hiccup is captured and brought before Excellinor the Witch, who takes his dragon Toothless and tortures him for the location of the human rebels' base, while the Dragon Rebellion and the fight over who will rule the Archipelago escalate around him.
jak-zradit-draciho-hrdinu.pitch: Hiccup is captured and brought before Excellinor the Witch, who takes Toothless and tortures him for the location of the human rebels' base. The focus is on want and why: Hiccup protecting the rebels, and Snotlout's arc turning on a personal betrayal. The Dragon Rebellion escalates around them in this penultimate volume.

jane-doe.blurb: A girl believed by her island village to be cursed crosses a portal into a labyrinthine Palace connecting many worlds to find her missing father, and runs into a crime lord who threatens every world the Palace joins.

kniha-m.blurb: A mysterious plague causes people to lose their shadows and, soon after, their memories; a husband searches for his newly shadowless wife while a woman's memory-loss diary and a besieged city's fate unfold in parallel.
kniha-m.pitch: A plague makes people lose their shadows and, soon after, their memories. It opens with a man's shadow vanishing at a market, and the idea has real consequences: forgetting something can unmake it. Ory searches for his newly shadowless wife, while a woman's memory-loss diary and a besieged city unfold alongside.

lacrimosa.blurb: Sascha, raised in a convent destroyed by vampires, can possess anyone she touches; she uses the power to hunt the vampires who ruined her family until she meets Raphael, who is immune to her.

likario.blurb: Likario is undergoing rapid growth, becoming a real city where humans, goblins and half-breeds alike find a place to live. But someone hidden in the old underground is quietly gathering allies, corrupting and intimidating, planning to seize power over the city on some dark night.

marcy-a-hadanka-od-sfingy.blurb: A girl afraid of the dark must overcome her fears and travel to Egypt to rescue her adventurer father from the clutches of a great Sphinx guarding a magical book.

maruska-pulnocni-a-velka-hmyzi-olympiada.blurb: At the insect school hidden in an old tree, Marnie and her friends compete to win the annual Great Critter Contest by any means necessary, until a classmate ends up in danger.

mesto-knih.blurb: A thief forges his way into the White King's palace guard, only to be assigned to watch over a vast underground library that turns out to hold dangerous secrets.

morska-panna.blurb: A mermaid takes human form to live as the wife of a Maine fisherman; after his death she is recruited by P.T. Barnum to perform as his mermaid attraction in 1840s New York.
morska-panna.pitch: A mermaid gives up the sea to live as a fisherman's wife in Maine and later becomes P.T. Barnum's living attraction in New York. Amelia is intelligent, determined and outspoken, against the way the era treats women and against the slavery she witnesses on tour. A character-carried historical fantasy.

naslouchac.blurb: A Great War divided the world into a habitable half, shielded by an energy field powered by a mineral called sklenit, and a poisoned wasteland. Ilan, one of the few born without deformity and gifted with a rare ability to hear the mineral, disguises herself as a boy to avoid being taken from her family as a sklenit miner.

nejchladnejsi-divka-ve-meste-chladu.blurb: In a United States ravaged by a vampire epidemic, seventeen-year-old Tana wakes from a party to find her friends slaughtered, and escapes with her infected ex-boyfriend and a chained vampire on a race to the walled quarantine city of Coldtown to save them all.
nejchladnejsi-divka-ve-meste-chladu.pitch: In a United States ravaged by a vampire epidemic, Tana wakes in a bathtub after a party to find everyone else dead, and escapes with her infected ex-boyfriend and a chained vampire toward the walled quarantine city of Coldtown. From there the book never stops moving, the rules of the vampirism hold throughout, and reviewers praise Tana as practical and driven rather than waiting to be rescued.

nejlepsi-den-pro-umirani.blurb: Thompson, a half-elf despised by both humans and elves, has made a home in the goblin city of Likario, hiring himself out as a mercenary, exploring old temples and fighting orcs and ancient monsters, with two goals: survive and keep his family alive, and take revenge on those who hurt him.

nejtemnejsi-cast-lesa.blurb: In the town of Fairfold, humans and the fae live in an uneasy truce built on tourism; when the horned boy who has slept in a glass coffin in the woods for years finally wakes, siblings Hazel and Ben are pulled into the danger the town has learned to ignore.

neslysno.blurb: In a mountain village where everyone has been deaf for generations, Fei is the first in living memory to hear again; she must use her new sense to uncover why her people are also losing their sight before they starve.
